    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.User;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
    
    import java.util.List;
    import java.util.Objects;
    
    @Service
    public class PermissionService {
        private final AuthUtils authUtils;
        private final UserMapper userMapper;
        private final CourseMapper courseMapper;
        private final TeachingClassMapper classMapper;
        private final ClassStudentMapper classStudentMapper;
    
        public PermissionService(AuthUtils authUtils,
                                 UserMapper userMapper,
                                 CourseMapper courseMapper,
                                 TeachingClassMapper classMapper,
                                 ClassStudentMapper classStudentMapper) {
            this.authUtils = authUtils;
            this.userMapper = userMapper;
            this.courseMapper = courseMapper;
            this.classMapper = classMapper;
            this.classStudentMapper = classStudentMapper;
        }
    
        public AuthUtils.LoginUser currentUser() {
            AuthUtils.LoginUser user = UserContext.get();
            if (user == null) {
                throw new BusinessException("请先登录");
            }
            return user;
        }
    
        /** Re-resolve a persisted actor for background work; a numeric identifier is not a role grant. */
        public AuthUtils.LoginUser resolveActiveUser(Integer userId) {
            if (userId == null || userId <= 0) throw new ForbiddenException("用户身份无效");
            User user = userMapper.selectById(userId);
            if (user == null || !Integer.valueOf(1).equals(user.getStatus()))
                throw new ForbiddenException("用户不存在或已停用");
            String role = authUtils.findAssignedRoleCode(userId);
            if (!List.of("teacher", "student", "admin").contains(role == null ? "" : role))
                throw new ForbiddenException("用户未分配有效角色");
            var actor = new AuthUtils.LoginUser();
            actor.setUserId(userId);actor.setUsername(user.getUsername());actor.setRoleCode(role);
            return actor;
        }
    
        /** Course directory visibility and administrative maintenance are not private-material rights. */
        public boolean canReadCourseMaterials(AuthUtils.LoginUser actor, Integer courseId) {
            if (actor == null || courseId == null || courseId <= 0) return false;
            AuthUtils.LoginUser active;
            try { active = resolveActiveUser(actor.getUserId()); }
            catch (ForbiddenException denied) { return false; }
            if (!Objects.equals(active.getRoleCode(), actor.getRoleCode())) return false;
            Course course = courseMapper.selectById(courseId);
            if (course == null) return false;
            if ("teacher".equals(active.getRoleCode())) return Objects.equals(course.getTeacherId(), active.getUserId());
            if (!"student".equals(active.getRoleCode()) || !Integer.valueOf(1).equals(course.getStatus())) return false;
            List<Integer> classIds = studentClassIds(active.getUserId());
            if (classIds.isEmpty()) return false;
            QueryWrapper<TeachingClass> query = new QueryWrapper<>();
            query.in("id", classIds).eq("course_id", courseId).eq("status", 1);
            return classMapper.selectList(query).stream().anyMatch(teachingClass ->
                    Objects.equals(teachingClass.getCourseId(), courseId) && Integer.valueOf(1).equals(teachingClass.getStatus()));
        }
    
        public boolean isAdmin() {
            return authUtils.isAdmin(currentUser());
        }
    
        public boolean isAdmin(AuthUtils.LoginUser user) {
            return authUtils.isAdmin(user);
        }
    
        public boolean isTeacher() {
            return authUtils.isTeacher(currentUser());
        }
    
        public boolean isTeacher(AuthUtils.LoginUser user) {
            return authUtils.isTeacher(user);
        }
    
        public boolean isStudent() {
            return authUtils.isStudent(currentUser());
        }
    
        public boolean isStudent(AuthUtils.LoginUser user) {
            return authUtils.isStudent(user);
        }
    
        public void requireAdmin() {
            if (!authUtils.isAdmin(currentUser())) {
                throw new ForbiddenException("仅管理员可操作");
            }
        }
    
        public void requireTeacherOrAdmin() {
            AuthUtils.LoginUser user = currentUser();
            if (!authUtils.isAdmin(user) && !authUtils.isTeacher(user)) {
                throw new ForbiddenException("仅教师或管理员可操作");
            }
        }
    
        public void requireStudent() {

        public boolean isStudentInClass(Integer classId, Integer studentId) {
            if (classId == null || studentId == null) {
                return false;
            }
            QueryWrapper<ClassStudent> query = new QueryWrapper<>();
            query.eq("class_id", classId)
                    .eq("student_id", studentId)
                    .eq("status", 1);
            return classStudentMapper.selectCount(query) > 0;
        }
    
        public List<Integer> studentClassIds(Integer studentId) {
            QueryWrapper<ClassStudent> query = new QueryWrapper<>();
            query.eq("student_id", studentId).eq("status", 1).orderByDesc("id");
            return classStudentMapper.selectList(query).stream()
                    .map(ClassStudent::getClassId)
                    .filter(id -> id != null && id > 0)
                    .distinct()
                    .toList();
        }
    
        public List<Integer> studentCourseIds(Integer studentId) {
            List<Integer> classIds = studentClassIds(studentId);
            if (classIds.isEmpty()) {
                return List.of();
            }
            QueryWrapper<TeachingClass> query = new QueryWrapper<>();
            query.in("id", classIds);
            return classMapper.selectList(query).stream()
                    .map(TeachingClass::getCourseId)
                    .filter(id -> id != null && id > 0)
                    .distinct()
                    .toList();
        }
    
        public List<Integer> teacherClassIds(Integer teacherId) {
            QueryWrapper<TeachingClass> query = new QueryWrapper<>();
            query.eq("teacher_id", teacherId);
            return classMapper.selectList(query).stream()
                    .map(TeachingClass::getId)
                    .filter(id -> id != null && id > 0)
                    .toList();
        }
    
        public List<Integer> teacherStudentIds(Integer teacherId) {
            List<Integer> classIds = teacherClassIds(teacherId);
            if (classIds.isEmpty()) {
                return List.of();
            }
            QueryWrapper<ClassStudent> query = new QueryWrapper<>();
            query.in("class_id", classIds).eq("status", 1);
            return classStudentMapper.selectList(query).stream()
                    .map(ClassStudent::getStudentId)
                    .filter(id -> id != null && id > 0)
                    .distinct()
                    .toList();
        }

    ---
    name: diagnosing-bugs
    description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.
    ---
    
    # Diagnosing Bugs
    
    A discipline for hard bugs. Skip phases only when explicitly justified.
    
    When exploring the codebase, read `GLOSSARY.md` (if it exists) to get a clear mental model of the relevant modules, and check ADRs in the area you're touching.
    
    ## Redact
    
    This skill has you show commands, outputs and captured artifacts. **Redact every secret first**: write `<REDACTED>` in its place. Build loops against env vars, so the credential stays in the environment rather than in what you show. Captured artifacts carry auth headers: quote only the lines that carry the signal.
    
    If the redacted output is not enough to diagnose the bug, say so and ask the user.
    
    ## Phase 1: Build a feedback loop
    
    **This is the skill.** Everything else is mechanical. If you have a **tight** pass/fail signal for the bug (one that goes red on _this_ bug), you will find the cause; bisection, hypothesis-testing, and instrumentation all just consume it. If you don't have one, no amount of staring at code will save you.
    
    Spend disproportionate effort here. **Be aggressive. Be creative. Refuse to give up.**
    
    ### Ways to construct one, in roughly this order
    
    1. **Failing test** at whatever seam reaches the bug: unit, integration, e2e.
    2. **Curl / HTTP script** against a running dev server.
    3. **CLI invocation** with a fixture input, diffing stdout against a known-good snapshot.
    4. **Headless browser script** (Playwright / Puppeteer) that drives the UI and asserts on DOM/console/network.
    5. **Replay a captured trace.** Save a real network request / payload / event log to disk; replay it through the code path in isolation.
    6. **Throwaway harness.** Spin up a minimal subset of the system (one service, mocked deps) that exercises the bug code path with a single function call.
    7. **Property / fuzz loop.** If the bug is "sometimes wrong output", run 1000 random inputs and look for the failure mode.
    8. **Bisection harness.** If the bug appeared between two known states (commit, dataset, version), automate "boot at state X, check, repeat" so you can `git bisect run` it.
    9. **Differential loop.** Run the same input through old-version vs new-version (or two configs) and diff outputs.
    10. **HITL bash script.** Last resort. If a human must click, drive _them_ with `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh` so the loop is still structured. Captured output feeds back to you.
    
    Build the right feedback loop, and the bug is 90% fixed.
    
    ### Tighten the loop
    
    Treat the loop as a product. Once you have _a_ loop, **tighten** it:
    
    - Can I make it faster? (Cache setup, skip unrelated init, narrow the test scope.)
    - Can I make the signal sharper? (Assert on the specific symptom, not "didn't crash".)
    - Can I make it more deterministic? (Pin time, seed RNG, isolate filesystem, freeze network.)
    
    A 30-second flaky loop is barely better than no loop; a 2-second deterministic one is tight, a debugging superpower.
    
    ### Non-deterministic bugs
    
    The goal is not a clean repro but a **higher reproduction rate**. Loop the trigger 100×, parallelise, add stress, narrow timing windows, inject sleeps. A 50%-flake bug is debuggable; 1% is not, so keep raising the rate until it's debuggable.
    
    ### When you genuinely cannot build a loop
    
    Stop and say so explicitly. List what you tried. Ask the user for: (a) access to whatever environment reproduces it, (b) a redacted captured artifact (HAR file, log dump, core dump, screen recording with timestamps), or (c) permission to add temporary production instrumentation. Do **not** proceed to hypothesise without a loop.
    
    ### Completion criterion: a tight loop that goes red
    
    Phase 1 is done when the loop is **tight** and **red-capable**: you can name **one command** (a script path, a test invocation, a curl) that you have **already run at least once** (show the invocation and its output, redacted), and that is:
    
    - [ ] **Red-capable**: it drives the actual bug code path and asserts the **user's exact symptom**, so it can go red on this bug and green once fixed. Not "runs without erroring"; it must be able to _catch this specific bug_.
    - [ ] **Deterministic**: same verdict every run (flaky bugs: a pinned, high reproduction rate, per above).
    - [ ] **Fast**: seconds, not minutes.
    - [ ] **Agent-runnable**: you can run it unattended; a human in the loop only via `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh`.
    
    If you catch yourself reading code to build a theory before this command exists, **stop: jumping straight to a hypothesis is the exact failure this skill prevents.** No red-capable command, no Phase 2.
    
    ## Phase 2: Reproduce + minimise
    
    Run the loop. Watch it go red as the bug appears.
    
    Confirm:
    
    - [ ] The loop produces the failure mode the **user** described, not a different failure that happens to be nearby. Wrong bug = wrong fix.
    - [ ] The failure is reproducible across multiple runs (or, for non-deterministic bugs, reproducible at a high enough rate to debug against).
    - [ ] You have captured the exact symptom (error message, wrong output, slow timing) so later phases can verify the fix actually addresses it.
    
    ### Minimise
    
    Once it's red, shrink the repro to the **smallest scenario that still goes red**. Cut inputs, callers, config, data, and steps **one at a time**, re-running the loop after each cut, and keep only what's load-bearing for the failure.
    
    Why bother: a minimal repro shrinks the hypothesis space in Phase 3 (fewer moving parts left to suspect) and becomes the clean regression test in Phase 5.
    
    Done when **every remaining element is load-bearing**: removing any one of them makes the loop go green.
    
    Do not proceed until you have reproduced **and** minimised.
    
    ## Phase 3: Hypothesise
    
    Generate **3–5 ranked hypotheses** before testing any of them. Single-hypothesis generation anchors on the first plausible idea.
    
    Each hypothesis must be **falsifiable**: state the prediction it makes.
    
    > Format: "If <X> is the cause, then <changing Y> will make the bug disappear / <changing Z> will make it worse."
    
    If you cannot state the prediction, the hypothesis is a vibe: discard or sharpen it.
    
    **Show the ranked list to the user before testing.** They often have domain knowledge that re-ranks instantly ("we just deployed a change to #3"), or know hypotheses they've already ruled out. Cheap checkpoint, big time saver. Don't block on it; proceed with your ranking if the user is AFK.
    
    ## Phase 4: Instrument
    
    Each probe must map to a specific prediction from Phase 3. **Change one variable at a time.**
    
    Tool preference:
    
    1. **Debugger / REPL inspection** if the env supports it. One breakpoint beats ten logs.
    2. **Targeted logs** at the boundaries that distinguish hypotheses.
    3. Never "log everything and grep".
    
    **Tag every debug log** with a unique prefix, e.g. `[DEBUG-a4f2]`. Cleanup at the end becomes a single grep. Untagged logs survive; tagged logs die.
    
    **Perf branch.** For performance regressions, logs are usually wrong. Instead: establish a baseline measurement (timing harness, `performance.now()`, profiler, query plan), then bisect. Measure first, fix second.
    
    ## Phase 5: Fix + regression test
    
    Write the regression test **before the fix**, but only if there is a **correct seam** for it.
    
    A correct seam is one where the test exercises the **real bug pattern** as it occurs at the call site. If the only available seam is too shallow (single-caller test when the bug needs multiple callers, unit test that can't replicate the chain that triggered the bug), a regression test there gives false confidence.
    
    **If no correct seam exists, that itself is the finding.** Note it. The codebase architecture is preventing the bug from being locked down. Flag this for the next phase.
    
    If a correct seam exists:
    
    1. Turn the minimised repro into a failing test at that seam.
    2. Watch it fail. If you forced the red by mutating code or a fixture, `diff` against a pristine copy to prove the mutation landed before you trust it.
    3. Apply the fix.
    4. Watch it pass.
    5. Re-run the Phase 1 feedback loop against the original (un-minimised) scenario.
    
    ## Phase 6: Cleanup
    
    Required before declaring done:
    
    - [ ] Original repro no longer reproduces (re-run the Phase 1 loop)
    - [ ] Regression test passes (or absence of seam is documented)
    - [ ] All `[DEBUG-...]` instrumentation removed (`grep` the prefix)
    - [ ] Throwaway prototypes deleted (or moved to a clearly-marked debug location)
    - [ ] The hypothesis that turned out correct is stated in the commit / PR message, so the next debugger learns

    package com.cupk.aiacademy.controller;
    
    import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.conditions.query.QueryWrapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.Result;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.dto.CourseCategoryDto;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.CourseCategoryMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.CourseMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.Course;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.CourseCategory;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.service.CourseResourceService;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.service.PermissionService;
    import jakarta.validation.Valid;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
    import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.DeleteMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PutMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
    
    import java.time.LocalDateTime;
    import java.util.HashMap;
    import java.util.Map;
    
    @RestController
    @RequestMapping("/categories")
    public class CategoryController {
        @Autowired
        private CourseCategoryMapper categoryMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private CourseMapper courseMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private CourseResourceService courseResourceService;
    
        @Autowired
        private PermissionService permissionService;
    
        @GetMapping
        public Result list() {
            QueryWrapper<CourseCategory> queryWrapper = new QueryWrapper<>();
            queryWrapper.orderByAsc("id");
            return Result.success(categoryMapper.selectList(queryWrapper));
        }
    
        @GetMapping("/{categoryId}/courses")
        public Result listCourses(@PathVariable Integer categoryId,
                                  @RequestParam(required = false) Integer status,
                                  @RequestParam(defaultValue = "1") Integer pageNum,
                                  @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10") Integer pageSize) {
            return Result.success(courseResourceService.listCoursesByCategory(categoryId, status, pageNum, pageSize));
        }
    
        @PostMapping
        public Result add(@Valid @RequestBody(required = false) CourseCategoryDto request) {
            permissionService.requireAdmin();
            CourseCategory category = request == null ? null : request.toEntity();
            Result checkResult = checkCategory(category);
            if (checkResult != null) {
                return checkResult;
            }
            category.setName(category.getName().trim());
            fixSortOrder(category);
            LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
            category.setCreateTime(now);
            category.setUpdateTime(now);
            int row = categoryMapper.insert(category);
            return row > 0 ? Result.success() : Result.error();
        }
    
        @PutMapping("/{id}")
        public Result update(@PathVariable Integer id, @Valid @RequestBody CourseCategoryDto request) {
            permissionService.requireAdmin();
            CourseCategory category = request.toEntity();
            if (categoryMapper.selectById(id) == null) {
                return Result.error("404", "分类不存在");
            }
            Result checkResult = checkCategory(category);
            if (checkResult != null) {
                return checkResult;
            }
            category.setId(id);
            category.setName(category.getName().trim());
            fixSortOrder(category);
            category.setUpdateTime(LocalDateTime.now());
            int row = categoryMapper.updateById(category);
            return row > 0 ? Result.success() : Result.error();
        }
    
        @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
        @Transactional(rollbackFor = Exception.class)
        public Result delete(@PathVariable Integer id, @RequestParam(required = false) Boolean cascade) {
            permissionService.requireAdmin();
            if (categoryMapper.selectById(id) == null) {
                return Result.error("404", "分类不存在");
            }
    
            QueryWrapper<Course> courseQuery = new QueryWrapper<>();
            courseQuery.eq("category_id", id);
            Long courseCount = courseMapper.selectCount(courseQuery);
    
            if (courseCount > 0 && !Boolean.TRUE.equals(cascade)) {
                Map<String, Object> data = new HashMap<>();
                data.put("hasCourses", true);
                data.put("courseCount", courseCount);
                return Result.error("409", "该分类下还有课程，请先处理课程或选择级联删除", data);
            }
    
            int deletedCourses = 0;
            if (courseCount > 0) {
                deletedCourses = courseMapper.delete(courseQuery);
            }
    
            int row = categoryMapper.deleteById(id);
            if (row <= 0) {
                return Result.error();
            }
    
            Map<String, Object> data = new HashMap<>();
            data.put("deletedCourses", deletedCourses);
            return Result.success(data);
        }
    
        private Result checkCategory(CourseCategory category) {
            if (category == null) {
                return Result.error("400", "分类信息不能为空");
            }
            if (category.getName() == null || category.getName().trim().isEmpty()) {
                return Result.error("400", "分类名称不能为空");
            }
            return null;
        }
    
        private void fixSortOrder(CourseCategory category) {
            if (category.getSortOrder() == null || category.getSortOrder() <= 0) {
                category.setSortOrder(null);
            }
        }
    }

        @Test
        void exceedingScreenSwitchLimitMarksSubmissionAsCheating() {
            setCurrentUser(TEACHER_ID, "teacher");
            QuestionResponseDTO question = questionService.create(buildSingleChoiceQuestion());
            PaperResponseDTO paper = paperService.create(buildPaperRequest(question.getId()));
    
            ExamRequestDTO examRequest = new ExamRequestDTO();
            examRequest.setClassId(CLASS_ID);
            examRequest.setName("反作弊测试考试");
            examRequest.setPaperId(paper.getId());
            examRequest.setDescription("切屏超过一次即作弊");
            examRequest.setStartTime(LocalDateTime.now().minusMinutes(1));
            examRequest.setDurationMinutes(60);
            examRequest.setStatus(ExamStatus.PUBLISHED);
            examRequest.setMaxScreenSwitches(1);
            examRequest.setDisableClipboard(true);
            var exam = examService.create(examRequest);
            assertEquals(1, exam.getMaxScreenSwitches());
            assertTrue(exam.getDisableClipboard());
    
            setCurrentUser(STUDENT_ID, "student");
            SubmissionResponseDTO submission = submissionService.start(exam.getId(), String.valueOf(STUDENT_ID));
    
            SubmissionResponseDTO firstSwitch = submissionService.reportScreenSwitch(submission.getId());
            assertEquals(1, firstSwitch.getScreenSwitchCount());
            assertEquals(false, firstSwitch.getCheated());
    
            SubmissionResponseDTO secondSwitch = submissionService.reportScreenSwitch(submission.getId());
            assertEquals(2, secondSwitch.getScreenSwitchCount());
            assertEquals(true, secondSwitch.getCheated());
            assertEquals(new BigDecimal("-1"), secondSwitch.getTotalScore());
            assertEquals(SubmissionStatus.GRADED, secondSwitch.getStatus());
            assertEquals(0, new BigDecimal("-1").compareTo(jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                    "SELECT total_score FROM t_exam_record WHERE id = ?", BigDecimal.class, submission.getId())));
            assertEquals(1, jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                    "SELECT cheated FROM t_exam_record WHERE id = ?", Integer.class, submission.getId()));
        }
    
        @Test
        void zeroScreenSwitchLimitMarksFirstSwitchAsCheating() {
            loginAsTeacher();
            var exam = createExam(ExamStatus.DRAFT);
            jdbcTemplate.update(
                    "UPDATE t_exam_session SET max_screen_switches = 0 WHERE id = ?",
                    exam.getId());
            examService.publish(exam.getId());
    
            loginAsStudent();
            var submission = submissionService.start(exam.getId(), "student-001");
            SubmissionResponseDTO switched = submissionService.reportScreenSwitch(submission.getId());
    
            assertEquals(1, switched.getScreenSwitchCount());
            assertTrue(switched.getCheated());
            assertEquals(new BigDecimal("-1"), switched.getTotalScore());
        }
    
        @Test
        void screenSwitchAfterDeadlineIsNotCounted() {
            loginAsTeacher();
            var exam = createExam(ExamStatus.DRAFT);
            examService.publish(exam.getId());
    
            loginAsStudent();
            var submission = submissionService.start(exam.getId(), "student-001");
            jdbcTemplate.update(
                    "UPDATE t_exam_session SET end_time = ? WHERE id = ?",
                    LocalDateTime.now().minusSeconds(1), exam.getId());
    
            SubmissionResponseDTO switched = submissionService.reportScreenSwitch(submission.getId());
    
            assertEquals(0, switched.getScreenSwitchCount());
            assertFalse(switched.getCheated());
            assertEquals(SubmissionStatus.IN_PROGRESS, switched.getStatus());
        }

        /** Re-resolve a persisted actor for background work; a numeric identifier is not a role grant. */
        public AuthUtils.LoginUser resolveActiveUser(Integer userId) {
            if (userId == null || userId <= 0) throw new ForbiddenException("用户身份无效");
            User user = userMapper.selectById(userId);
            if (user == null || !Integer.valueOf(1).equals(user.getStatus()))
                throw new ForbiddenException("用户不存在或已停用");
            String role = authUtils.findAssignedRoleCode(userId);
            if (!List.of("teacher", "student", "admin").contains(role == null ? "" : role))
                throw new ForbiddenException("用户未分配有效角色");
            var actor = new AuthUtils.LoginUser();
            actor.setUserId(userId);actor.setUsername(user.getUsername());actor.setRoleCode(role);
            return actor;
        }
    
        /** Course directory visibility and administrative maintenance are not private-material rights. */
        public boolean canReadCourseMaterials(AuthUtils.LoginUser actor, Integer courseId) {
            if (actor == null || courseId == null || courseId <= 0) return false;
            AuthUtils.LoginUser active;
            try { active = resolveActiveUser(actor.getUserId()); }
            catch (ForbiddenException denied) { return false; }
            if (!Objects.equals(active.getRoleCode(), actor.getRoleCode())) return false;
            Course course = courseMapper.selectById(courseId);
            if (course == null) return false;
            if ("teacher".equals(active.getRoleCode())) return Objects.equals(course.getTeacherId(), active.getUserId());
            if (!"student".equals(active.getRoleCode()) || !Integer.valueOf(1).equals(course.getStatus())) return false;
            List<Integer> classIds = studentClassIds(active.getUserId());
            if (classIds.isEmpty()) return false;
            QueryWrapper<TeachingClass> query = new QueryWrapper<>();
            query.in("id", classIds).eq("course_id", courseId).eq("status", 1);
            return classMapper.selectList(query).stream().anyMatch(teachingClass ->
                    Objects.equals(teachingClass.getCourseId(), courseId) && Integer.valueOf(1).equals(teachingClass.getStatus()));
        }

    package com.cupk.aiacademy.config;
    
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.AuthUtils;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.UserContext;
    import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
    import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    import org.springframework.web.servlet.AsyncHandlerInterceptor;
    
    @Component
    public class AuthInterceptor implements AsyncHandlerInterceptor {
    
        @Autowired(required = false)
        private AuthUtils authUtils;
    
        @Override
        public boolean preHandle(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, Object handler) {
            UserContext.clear();
            String authorization = request.getHeader("Authorization");
    
            if (authUtils == null) {
                return true;
            }
    
            if (needsAuth(request)) {
                if (authorization == null || !authorization.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
                    response.setStatus(401);
                    return false;
                }
            }
    
            if (authorization != null && authorization.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
                try {
                    AuthUtils.LoginUser user = authUtils.requireLogin(authorization);
                    UserContext.set(user);
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    response.setStatus(401);
                    return false;
                }
            }
    
            return true;
        }
    
        @Override
        public void afterCompletion(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, Object handler, Exception ex) {
            UserContext.clear();
        }
    
        @Override
        public void afterConcurrentHandlingStarted(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, Object handler) {
            // SSE leaves the servlet thread before afterCompletion; never leak its user into the next request.
            UserContext.clear();
        }
    
        private boolean needsAuth(HttpServletRequest request) {
            String path = request.getRequestURI();
    
            if (path.matches(".*/auth/(login|register).*")) {
                return false;
            }
            if ("/teacher-applications".equals(path) && "POST".equalsIgnoreCase(request.getMethod())) {
                return false;
            }
            if (path.startsWith("/uploads")) {
                return false;
            }
            if (path.startsWith("/media")) {
                return false;
            }
            if ("/api/home-course-recommendations".equals(path)
                    && "GET".equalsIgnoreCase(request.getMethod())) {
                return false;
            }
    
            return true;
        }
    }

    package com.cupk.aiacademy.controller;
    
    import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.conditions.query.QueryWrapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.Result;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.dto.CourseCategoryDto;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.CourseCategoryMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.CourseMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.Course;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.CourseCategory;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.service.CourseResourceService;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.service.PermissionService;
    import jakarta.validation.Valid;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
    import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.DeleteMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PutMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
    
    import java.time.LocalDateTime;
    import java.util.HashMap;
    import java.util.Map;
    
    @RestController
    @RequestMapping("/categories")
    public class CategoryController {
        @Autowired
        private CourseCategoryMapper categoryMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private CourseMapper courseMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private CourseResourceService courseResourceService;
    
        @Autowired
        private PermissionService permissionService;
    
        @GetMapping
        public Result list() {
            QueryWrapper<CourseCategory> queryWrapper = new QueryWrapper<>();
            queryWrapper.orderByAsc("id");
            return Result.success(categoryMapper.selectList(queryWrapper));
        }
    
        @GetMapping("/{categoryId}/courses")
        public Result listCourses(@PathVariable Integer categoryId,
                                  @RequestParam(required = false) Integer status,
                                  @RequestParam(defaultValue = "1") Integer pageNum,
                                  @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10") Integer pageSize) {
            return Result.success(courseResourceService.listCoursesByCategory(categoryId, status, pageNum, pageSize));
        }
    
        @PostMapping
        public Result add(@Valid @RequestBody(required = false) CourseCategoryDto request) {
            permissionService.requireAdmin();
            CourseCategory category = request == null ? null : request.toEntity();
            Result checkResult = checkCategory(category);
            if (checkResult != null) {
                return checkResult;
            }
            category.setName(category.getName().trim());
            fixSortOrder(category);
            LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
            category.setCreateTime(now);
            category.setUpdateTime(now);
            int row = categoryMapper.insert(category);
            return row > 0 ? Result.success() : Result.error();
        }
    
        @PutMapping("/{id}")
        public Result update(@PathVariable Integer id, @Valid @RequestBody CourseCategoryDto request) {
            permissionService.requireAdmin();
            CourseCategory category = request.toEntity();
            if (categoryMapper.selectById(id) == null) {
                return Result.error("404", "分类不存在");
            }
            Result checkResult = checkCategory(category);
            if (checkResult != null) {
                return checkResult;
            }
            category.setId(id);
            category.setName(category.getName().trim());
            fixSortOrder(category);
            category.setUpdateTime(LocalDateTime.now());
            int row = categoryMapper.updateById(category);
            return row > 0 ? Result.success() : Result.error();
        }
    
        @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
        @Transactional(rollbackFor = Exception.class)
        public Result delete(@PathVariable Integer id, @RequestParam(required = false) Boolean cascade) {
            permissionService.requireAdmin();
            if (categoryMapper.selectById(id) == null) {
                return Result.error("404", "分类不存在");
            }
    
            QueryWrapper<Course> courseQuery = new QueryWrapper<>();
            courseQuery.eq("category_id", id);
            Long courseCount = courseMapper.selectCount(courseQuery);
    
            if (courseCount > 0 && !Boolean.TRUE.equals(cascade)) {
                Map<String, Object> data = new HashMap<>();
                data.put("hasCourses", true);
                data.put("courseCount", courseCount);
                return Result.error("409", "该分类下还有课程，请先处理课程或选择级联删除", data);
            }
    
            int deletedCourses = 0;
            if (courseCount > 0) {
                deletedCourses = courseMapper.delete(courseQuery);
            }
    
            int row = categoryMapper.deleteById(id);
            if (row <= 0) {
                return Result.error();
            }
    
            Map<String, Object> data = new HashMap<>();
            data.put("deletedCourses", deletedCourses);
            return Result.success(data);
        }
    
        private Result checkCategory(CourseCategory category) {
            if (category == null) {
                return Result.error("400", "分类信息不能为空");
            }
            if (category.getName() == null || category.getName().trim().isEmpty()) {
                return Result.error("400", "分类名称不能为空");
            }
            return null;
        }
    
        private void fixSortOrder(CourseCategory category) {
            if (category.getSortOrder() == null || category.getSortOrder() <= 0) {
                category.setSortOrder(null);
            }
        }
    }

    package com.cupk.aiacademy.service;
    
    import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.conditions.query.QueryWrapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.AuthUtils;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.BusinessException;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.ForbiddenException;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.UserContext;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.ClassStudentMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.CourseMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.TeachingClassMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.UserMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.ClassStudent;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.Course;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.ExamPaper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.ExamSession;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.Homework;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.HomeworkPaper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.HomeworkSession;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.TeachingClass;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.User;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
    
    import java.util.List;
    import java.util.Objects;
    
    @Service
    public class PermissionService {
        private final AuthUtils authUtils;
        private final UserMapper userMapper;
        private final CourseMapper courseMapper;
        private final TeachingClassMapper classMapper;
        private final ClassStudentMapper classStudentMapper;
    
        public PermissionService(AuthUtils authUtils,
                                 UserMapper userMapper,
                                 CourseMapper courseMapper,
                                 TeachingClassMapper classMapper,
                                 ClassStudentMapper classStudentMapper) {
            this.authUtils = authUtils;
            this.userMapper = userMapper;
            this.courseMapper = courseMapper;
            this.classMapper = classMapper;
            this.classStudentMapper = classStudentMapper;
        }
    
        public AuthUtils.LoginUser currentUser() {
            AuthUtils.LoginUser user = UserContext.get();
            if (user == null) {
                throw new BusinessException("请先登录");
            }
            return user;
        }
    
        /** Re-resolve a persisted actor for background work; a numeric identifier is not a role grant. */
        public AuthUtils.LoginUser resolveActiveUser(Integer userId) {
            if (userId == null || userId <= 0) throw new ForbiddenException("用户身份无效");
            User user = userMapper.selectById(userId);
            if (user == null || !Integer.valueOf(1).equals(user.getStatus()))
                throw new ForbiddenException("用户不存在或已停用");
            String role = authUtils.findAssignedRoleCode(userId);
            if (!List.of("teacher", "student", "admin").contains(role == null ? "" : role))
                throw new ForbiddenException("用户未分配有效角色");
            var actor = new AuthUtils.LoginUser();
            actor.setUserId(userId);actor.setUsername(user.getUsername());actor.setRoleCode(role);
            return actor;
        }
    
        /** Course directory visibility and administrative maintenance are not private-material rights. */
        public boolean canReadCourseMaterials(AuthUtils.LoginUser actor, Integer courseId) {
            if (actor == null || courseId == null || courseId <= 0) return false;
            AuthUtils.LoginUser active;
            try { active = resolveActiveUser(actor.getUserId()); }
            catch (ForbiddenException denied) { return false; }
            if (!Objects.equals(active.getRoleCode(), actor.getRoleCode())) return false;
            Course course = courseMapper.selectById(courseId);
            if (course == null) return false;
            if ("teacher".equals(active.getRoleCode())) return Objects.equals(course.getTeacherId(), active.getUserId());
            if (!"student".equals(active.getRoleCode()) || !Integer.valueOf(1).equals(course.getStatus())) return false;
            List<Integer> classIds = studentClassIds(active.getUserId());
            if (classIds.isEmpty()) return false;
            QueryWrapper<TeachingClass> query = new QueryWrapper<>();
            query.in("id", classIds).eq("course_id", courseId).eq("status", 1);
            return classMapper.selectList(query).stream().anyMatch(teachingClass ->
                    Objects.equals(teachingClass.getCourseId(), courseId) && Integer.valueOf(1).equals(teachingClass.getStatus()));
        }
    
        public boolean isAdmin() {
            return authUtils.isAdmin(currentUser());
        }
    
        public boolean isAdmin(AuthUtils.LoginUser user) {
            return authUtils.isAdmin(user);
        }
    
        public boolean isTeacher() {
            return authUtils.isTeacher(currentUser());
        }

    package com.cupk.aiacademy.common;

    import io.jsonwebtoken.Claims;
    import lombok.Data;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    
    @Component
    public class AuthUtils {
        @Autowired
        private JwtUtils jwtUtils;
    
        @Autowired
        private UserMapper userMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private UserRoleMapper userRoleMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private RoleMapper roleMapper;
    
        public LoginUser requireLogin(String authorization) {
            if (authorization == null || !authorization.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("请先登录");
            }
            Claims claims = jwtUtils.parseToken(authorization.substring(7));
            Object userIdValue = claims.get("userId");
            if (!(userIdValue instanceof Number)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("登录状态已失效");
            }
    
            Integer userId = ((Number) userIdValue).intValue();
            User dbUser = userMapper.selectById(userId);
            if (dbUser == null || dbUser.getStatus() == null || dbUser.getStatus() == 0) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("登录状态已失效");
            }
    
            LoginUser loginUser = new LoginUser();
            loginUser.setUserId(userId);
            loginUser.setUsername(dbUser.getUsername() == null ? claims.getSubject() : dbUser.getUsername());
            loginUser.setRoleCode(findRoleCode(userId));
            return loginUser;
        }
    
        public boolean isAdmin(LoginUser user) {
            return user != null && "admin".equals(user.getRoleCode());
        }
    
        public boolean isTeacher(LoginUser user) {
            return user != null && "teacher".equals(user.getRoleCode());
        }
    
        public boolean isStudent(LoginUser user) {
            return user != null && "student".equals(user.getRoleCode());
        }
    
        public String findRoleCode(Integer userId) {
            String assigned = findAssignedRoleCode(userId);
            return assigned == null ? "student" : assigned;
        }
    
        /** Strict lookup for authorization that must distinguish an assignment from the legacy default. */
        public String findAssignedRoleCode(Integer userId) {
            if (userId == null) {
                return null;
            }
            UserRole userRole = userRoleMapper.selectOne(new QueryWrapper<UserRole>().eq("user_id", userId));
            if (userRole == null || userRole.getRoleId() == null) {
                return null;
            }
            Role role = roleMapper.selectById(userRole.getRoleId());
            return role == null ? null : role.getRoleCode();
        }
    
        @Data
        public static class LoginUser {
            private Integer userId;
            private String username;
            private String roleCode;
        }
    }

    package com.cupk.aiacademy.config;
    
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.AuthUtils;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.UserContext;
    import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
    import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    import org.springframework.web.servlet.AsyncHandlerInterceptor;
    
    @Component
    public class AuthInterceptor implements AsyncHandlerInterceptor {
    
        @Autowired(required = false)
        private AuthUtils authUtils;
    
        @Override
        public boolean preHandle(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, Object handler) {
            UserContext.clear();
            String authorization = request.getHeader("Authorization");
    
            if (authUtils == null) {
                return true;
            }
    
            if (needsAuth(request)) {
                if (authorization == null || !authorization.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
                    response.setStatus(401);
                    return false;
                }
            }
    
            if (authorization != null && authorization.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
                try {
                    AuthUtils.LoginUser user = authUtils.requireLogin(authorization);
                    UserContext.set(user);
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    response.setStatus(401);
                    return false;
                }
            }
    
            return true;
        }
    
        @Override
        public void afterCompletion(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, Object handler, Exception ex) {
            UserContext.clear();
        }
    
        @Override
        public void afterConcurrentHandlingStarted(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, Object handler) {
            // SSE leaves the servlet thread before afterCompletion; never leak its user into the next request.
            UserContext.clear();
        }
    
        private boolean needsAuth(HttpServletRequest request) {
            String path = request.getRequestURI();
    
            if (path.matches(".*/auth/(login|register).*")) {
                return false;
            }
            if ("/teacher-applications".equals(path) && "POST".equalsIgnoreCase(request.getMethod())) {
                return false;
            }
            if (path.startsWith("/uploads")) {
                return false;
            }
            if (path.startsWith("/media")) {
                return false;
            }
            if ("/api/home-course-recommendations".equals(path)
                    && "GET".equalsIgnoreCase(request.getMethod())) {
                return false;
            }
    
            return true;
        }
    }

                AuthUtils.LoginUser actor = new AuthUtils.LoginUser();
                actor.setUserId(1);

                doReturn(actor).when(auth).requireLogin("Bearer " + role);

            CategoryController controller = new CategoryController();

            ReflectionTestUtils.setField(controller, "permissionService", permissions);
            AuthInterceptor interceptor = new AuthInterceptor();
            ReflectionTestUtils.setField(interceptor, "authUtils", auth);
            mvc = MockMvcBuilders.standaloneSetup(controller)
                    .setControllerAdvice(new GlobalExceptionHandler())
                    .addInterceptors(interceptor).build();
        }

        void nonAdminsCannotWriteAndAnonymousMustAuthenticate() throws Exception {
            for (String role : List.of("student", "teacher")) {
                for (MockHttpServletRequestBuilder request : writes()) {
                    mvc.perform(request.header("Authorization", "Bearer " + role))

            }

    STRUCTURED_SECRET_NAME = re.compile(r"(?:api[_-]?key|auth[_-]?token|access[_-]?token|token|secret|password)$", re.IGNORECASE)

    def parse_time(value: str) -> dt.datetime:

        if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() is None:

        return parsed.astimezone(dt.timezone.utc)
    
    
    def collect_secrets(environ: Mapping[str, str], private_env_files: Sequence[Path]) -> set[str]:
        """Read secrets for replacement only; no values or secret hashes enter reports."""
        values = {str(value) for name, value in environ.items() if SECRET_NAME.search(name) and value}
        for filename in private_env_files:
            for line in Path(filename).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").splitlines():
                match = re.match(r"^\s*(?:export\s+)?([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=(.*)$", line)
                if not match or not SECRET_NAME.search(match[1]):

                if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in "\"'":

            self.secrets = sorted(secrets, key=len, reverse=True)
    
        def text(self, text: str) -> str:

            result = OPAQUE_TRANSPORT.sub("[OPAQUE PLATFORM PAYLOAD OMITTED]", result)
            result = BINARY_DATA_URL.sub("[BINARY DATA OMITTED]", result)
            for secret in self.secrets:
                if len(secret) >= 4:
                    result = result.replace(secret, REDACTED)
                else:
                    result = re.sub(r"(?<!\w)" + re.escape(secret) + r"(?!\w)", REDACTED, result)
            result = BEARER.sub("Bearer " + REDACTED, result)
            result = SK_KEY.sub(REDACTED, result)
            result = URL_USERINFO.sub(r"\1" + REDACTED + "@", result)
            result = URL_SECRET_QUERY.sub(r"\1" + REDACTED, result)
    
            def assignment(match: re.Match) -> str:
                prefix, value = match.groups()
                bare = value[1:-1] if value[:1] in "\"'" and value[-1:] == value[:1] else value
                if not bare or bare.startswith(("$", "%", "<", "[REDACTED]", "os.environ", "os.getenv", "System.getenv")):
                    return match[0]
                quote = value[0] if value[:1] in "\"'" else ""
                return prefix + quote + REDACTED + quote
    
            return SECRET_ASSIGNMENT.sub(assignment, result)

            if isinstance(value, list):

                    if OPAQUE_CONTENT_FIELD.search(value):
                        return "[OPAQUE PLATFORM CONTENT OMITTED FROM MIXED TOOL OUTPUT]"
                    return self.text(value)

                return value if safe == decoded else json.dumps(safe, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))

                        and (item.get("type") in {"reasoning", "encrypted_content"}
                             or item.get("channel") == "analysis" or item.get("phase") == "analysis"))]
            if isinstance(value, dict):

                if value.get("type") in {"reasoning", "encrypted_content"} or value.get("channel") == "analysis" or value.get("phase") == "analysis":
                    return "[INTERNAL CONTENT OMITTED]"
                return {key: (REDACTED if STRUCTURED_SECRET_NAME.search(str(key)) and item else self.tool_output(item))
                        for key, item in value.items() if key not in HIDDEN_FIELDS}
            return value
    
    
    def visible_content(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
        content = payload.get("content", [])
        if isinstance(content, str):
            return [{"type": "text", "text": content}]
        return [{"type": item["type"], "text": item["text"]} for item in content
                if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") in {"input_text", "output_text", "text"}
                and isinstance(item.get("text"), str)]
    
    
    def project_event(payload: dict[str, Any], source_line: int, timestamp: str,
                      session_id: str, calls: dict[str, tuple[str, int]]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        """Whitelist visible fields instead of copying the source payload wholesale."""
        kind = payload.get("type")
        base: dict[str, Any] = {"source_line": source_line, "timestamp": timestamp, "session_id": session_id}
        if kind == "message":
            role = payload.get("role")
            channel = payload.get("channel") or payload.get("phase")
            if channel == "final_answer":
                channel = "final"
            if role not in {"user", "assistant"} or (role == "assistant" and channel not in VISIBLE_CHANNELS):
                return None
            content = visible_content(payload)
            if not content:
                return None
            base.update(event_type="message", role=role, channel=channel, content=content)
        elif kind in CALL_TYPES:
            base.update(event_type="tool_call", call_id=payload.get("call_id"), name=payload.get("name"),
                        tool_type=kind)
            if "namespace" in payload:
                base["namespace"] = payload["namespace"]
            for field in ("arguments", "input"):
                if field in payload:
                    base[field] = payload[field]

    package com.cupk.aiacademy.controller;
    
    import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.conditions.query.QueryWrapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.Result;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.dto.CourseCategoryDto;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.CourseCategoryMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.CourseMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.Course;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.CourseCategory;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.service.CourseResourceService;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.service.PermissionService;
    import jakarta.validation.Valid;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
    import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.DeleteMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PutMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
    
    import java.time.LocalDateTime;
    import java.util.HashMap;
    import java.util.Map;
    
    @RestController
    @RequestMapping("/categories")
    public class CategoryController {
        @Autowired
        private CourseCategoryMapper categoryMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private CourseMapper courseMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private CourseResourceService courseResourceService;
    
        @Autowired
        private PermissionService permissionService;
    
        @GetMapping
        public Result list() {
            QueryWrapper<CourseCategory> queryWrapper = new QueryWrapper<>();
            queryWrapper.orderByAsc("id");
            return Result.success(categoryMapper.selectList(queryWrapper));
        }
    
        @GetMapping("/{categoryId}/courses")
        public Result listCourses(@PathVariable Integer categoryId,
                                  @RequestParam(required = false) Integer status,
                                  @RequestParam(defaultValue = "1") Integer pageNum,
                                  @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10") Integer pageSize) {
            return Result.success(courseResourceService.listCoursesByCategory(categoryId, status, pageNum, pageSize));
        }
    
        @PostMapping
        public Result add(@Valid @RequestBody(required = false) CourseCategoryDto request) {
            permissionService.requireAdmin();
            CourseCategory category = request == null ? null : request.toEntity();
            Result checkResult = checkCategory(category);
            if (checkResult != null) {
                return checkResult;
            }
            category.setName(category.getName().trim());
            fixSortOrder(category);
            LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
            category.setCreateTime(now);
            category.setUpdateTime(now);
            int row = categoryMapper.insert(category);
            return row > 0 ? Result.success() : Result.error();
        }
    
        @PutMapping("/{id}")
        public Result update(@PathVariable Integer id, @Valid @RequestBody CourseCategoryDto request) {
            permissionService.requireAdmin();
            CourseCategory category = request.toEntity();
            if (categoryMapper.selectById(id) == null) {
                return Result.error("404", "分类不存在");
            }
            Result checkResult = checkCategory(category);
            if (checkResult != null) {
                return checkResult;
            }
            category.setId(id);
            category.setName(category.getName().trim());
            fixSortOrder(category);
            category.setUpdateTime(LocalDateTime.now());
            int row = categoryMapper.updateById(category);
            return row > 0 ? Result.success() : Result.error();
        }
    
        @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
        @Transactional(rollbackFor = Exception.class)
        public Result delete(@PathVariable Integer id, @RequestParam(required = false) Boolean cascade) {
            permissionService.requireAdmin();
            if (categoryMapper.selectById(id) == null) {
                return Result.error("404", "分类不存在");
            }
    
            QueryWrapper<Course> courseQuery = new QueryWrapper<>();
            courseQuery.eq("category_id", id);
            Long courseCount = courseMapper.selectCount(courseQuery);
    
            if (courseCount > 0 && !Boolean.TRUE.equals(cascade)) {
                Map<String, Object> data = new HashMap<>();
                data.put("hasCourses", true);
                data.put("courseCount", courseCount);
                return Result.error("409", "该分类下还有课程，请先处理课程或选择级联删除", data);
            }
    
            int deletedCourses = 0;
            if (courseCount > 0) {
                deletedCourses = courseMapper.delete(courseQuery);
            }
    
            int row = categoryMapper.deleteById(id);
            if (row <= 0) {
                return Result.error();
            }
    
            Map<String, Object> data = new HashMap<>();
            data.put("deletedCourses", deletedCourses);
            return Result.success(data);
        }
    
        private Result checkCategory(CourseCategory category) {
            if (category == null) {
                return Result.error("400", "分类信息不能为空");
            }
            if (category.getName() == null || category.getName().trim().isEmpty()) {
                return Result.error("400", "分类名称不能为空");
            }
            return null;
        }
    
        private void fixSortOrder(CourseCategory category) {
            if (category.getSortOrder() == null || category.getSortOrder() <= 0) {
                category.setSortOrder(null);
            }
        }
    }

    package com.cupk.aiacademy.controller;
    
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.AuthUtils;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.GlobalExceptionHandler;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.config.AuthInterceptor;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.ClassStudentMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.CourseCategoryMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.CourseMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.TeachingClassMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.UserMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.CourseCategory;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.service.CourseResourceService;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.service.PermissionService;
    import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
    import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
    import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
    import org.springframework.test.util.ReflectionTestUtils;
    import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;
    import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockHttpServletRequestBuilder;
    import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.setup.MockMvcBuilders;
    
    import java.util.List;
    
    import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
    import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;
    import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.*;
    import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.status;
    
    class CategoryAuthorizationTest {
        private CourseCategoryMapper categories;
        private CourseMapper courses;
        private MockMvc mvc;
    
        @BeforeEach
        void setUp() {
            categories = mock(CourseCategoryMapper.class);
            courses = mock(CourseMapper.class);
            AuthUtils auth = spy(new AuthUtils());
            for (String role : List.of("student", "teacher", "admin")) {
                AuthUtils.LoginUser actor = new AuthUtils.LoginUser();
                actor.setUserId(1);
                actor.setRoleCode(role);
                doReturn(actor).when(auth).requireLogin("Bearer " + role);
            }
            PermissionService permissions = new PermissionService(auth, mock(UserMapper.class), courses,
                    mock(TeachingClassMapper.class), mock(ClassStudentMapper.class));
            CategoryController controller = new CategoryController();
            ReflectionTestUtils.setField(controller, "categoryMapper", categories);
            ReflectionTestUtils.setField(controller, "courseMapper", courses);
            ReflectionTestUtils.setField(controller, "courseResourceService", mock(CourseResourceService.class));
            ReflectionTestUtils.setField(controller, "permissionService", permissions);
            AuthInterceptor interceptor = new AuthInterceptor();
            ReflectionTestUtils.setField(interceptor, "authUtils", auth);
            mvc = MockMvcBuilders.standaloneSetup(controller)
                    .setControllerAdvice(new GlobalExceptionHandler())
                    .addInterceptors(interceptor).build();
        }
    
        @Test
        void nonAdminsCannotWriteAndAnonymousMustAuthenticate() throws Exception {
            for (String role : List.of("student", "teacher")) {
                for (MockHttpServletRequestBuilder request : writes()) {
                    mvc.perform(request.header("Authorization", "Bearer " + role))
                            .andExpect(status().isForbidden());
                }
            }
            for (MockHttpServletRequestBuilder request : writes()) {
                mvc.perform(request).andExpect(status().isUnauthorized());
            }
            verifyNoInteractions(categories, courses);
        }
    
        @Test
        void adminCanWriteIncludingCascade() throws Exception {
            when(categories.insert(any(CourseCategory.class))).thenReturn(1);
            when(categories.selectById(7)).thenReturn(new CourseCategory());
            when(categories.updateById(any(CourseCategory.class))).thenReturn(1);
            when(categories.deleteById(7)).thenReturn(1);
            when(courses.selectCount(any())).thenReturn(0L, 1L);
            when(courses.delete(any())).thenReturn(1);
            for (MockHttpServletRequestBuilder request : writes()) {
                mvc.perform(request.header("Authorization", "Bearer [REDACTED]")).andExpect(status().isOk());
            }
            verify(categories).insert(any(CourseCategory.class));
            verify(categories).updateById(any(CourseCategory.class));
            verify(categories, times(2)).deleteById(7);
            verify(courses).delete(any());
        }
    
        @Test
        void authenticatedUsersCanRead() throws Exception {
            when(categories.selectList(any())).thenReturn(List.of());
            for (String role : List.of("student", "teacher", "admin")) {
                mvc.perform(get("/categories").header("Authorization", "Bearer " + role))
                        .andExpect(status().isOk());
            }
            verify(categories, times(3)).selectList(any());
        }
    
        private List<MockHttpServletRequestBuilder> writes() {
            String body = "{\"name\":\"Test category\"}";
            return List.of(post("/categories").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).content(body),
                    put("/categories/7").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).content(body),
                    delete("/categories/7"), delete("/categories/7").param("cascade", "true"));
        }
    }

    package com.cupk.aiacademy.common;
    
    import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.conditions.query.QueryWrapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.RoleMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.UserMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.UserRoleMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.Role;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.User;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.UserRole;
    import io.jsonwebtoken.Claims;
    import lombok.Data;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    
    @Component
    public class AuthUtils {
        @Autowired
        private JwtUtils jwtUtils;
    
        @Autowired
        private UserMapper userMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private UserRoleMapper userRoleMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private RoleMapper roleMapper;
    
        public LoginUser requireLogin(String authorization) {
            if (authorization == null || !authorization.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("请先登录");
            }
            Claims claims = jwtUtils.parseToken(authorization.substring(7));
            Object userIdValue = claims.get("userId");
            if (!(userIdValue instanceof Number)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("登录状态已失效");
            }
    
            Integer userId = ((Number) userIdValue).intValue();
            User dbUser = userMapper.selectById(userId);
            if (dbUser == null || dbUser.getStatus() == null || dbUser.getStatus() == 0) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("登录状态已失效");
            }
    
            LoginUser loginUser = new LoginUser();
            loginUser.setUserId(userId);
            loginUser.setUsername(dbUser.getUsername() == null ? claims.getSubject() : dbUser.getUsername());
            loginUser.setRoleCode(findRoleCode(userId));
            return loginUser;
        }
    
        public boolean isAdmin(LoginUser user) {
            return user != null && "admin".equals(user.getRoleCode());
        }
    
        public boolean isTeacher(LoginUser user) {
            return user != null && "teacher".equals(user.getRoleCode());
        }
    
        public boolean isStudent(LoginUser user) {
            return user != null && "student".equals(user.getRoleCode());
        }
    
        public String findRoleCode(Integer userId) {
            String assigned = findAssignedRoleCode(userId);
            return assigned == null ? "student" : assigned;
        }
    
        /** Strict lookup for authorization that must distinguish an assignment from the legacy default. */
        public String findAssignedRoleCode(Integer userId) {
            if (userId == null) {
                return null;
            }
            UserRole userRole = userRoleMapper.selectOne(new QueryWrapper<UserRole>().eq("user_id", userId));
            if (userRole == null || userRole.getRoleId() == null) {
                return null;
            }
            Role role = roleMapper.selectById(userRole.getRoleId());
            return role == null ? null : role.getRoleCode();
        }
    
        @Data
        public static class LoginUser {
            private Integer userId;
            private String username;
            private String roleCode;
        }
    }

    import jakarta.validation.Valid;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;

    import java.time.LocalDateTime;
    import java.util.HashMap;
    import java.util.Map;
    
    @RestController
    @RequestMapping("/categories")
    public class CategoryController {
        @Autowired
        private CourseCategoryMapper categoryMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private CourseMapper courseMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private CourseResourceService courseResourceService;
    
        @Autowired
        private PermissionService permissionService;
    
        @GetMapping
        public Result list() {
            QueryWrapper<CourseCategory> queryWrapper = new QueryWrapper<>();
            queryWrapper.orderByAsc("id");
            return Result.success(categoryMapper.selectList(queryWrapper));
        }
    
        @GetMapping("/{categoryId}/courses")
        public Result listCourses(@PathVariable Integer categoryId,
                                  @RequestParam(required = false) Integer status,
                                  @RequestParam(defaultValue = "1") Integer pageNum,
                                  @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10") Integer pageSize) {
            return Result.success(courseResourceService.listCoursesByCategory(categoryId, status, pageNum, pageSize));
        }
    
        @PostMapping
        public Result add(@Valid @RequestBody(required = false) CourseCategoryDto request) {
            permissionService.requireAdmin();
            CourseCategory category = request == null ? null : request.toEntity();
            Result checkResult = checkCategory(category);
            if (checkResult != null) {
                return checkResult;
            }
            category.setName(category.getName().trim());
            fixSortOrder(category);
            LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
            category.setCreateTime(now);
            category.setUpdateTime(now);
            int row = categoryMapper.insert(category);
            return row > 0 ? Result.success() : Result.error();
        }
    
        @PutMapping("/{id}")
        public Result update(@PathVariable Integer id, @Valid @RequestBody CourseCategoryDto request) {
            permissionService.requireAdmin();
            CourseCategory category = request.toEntity();
            if (categoryMapper.selectById(id) == null) {
                return Result.error("404", "分类不存在");
            }
            Result checkResult = checkCategory(category);
            if (checkResult != null) {
                return checkResult;
            }
            category.setId(id);
            category.setName(category.getName().trim());
            fixSortOrder(category);
            category.setUpdateTime(LocalDateTime.now());
            int row = categoryMapper.updateById(category);
            return row > 0 ? Result.success() : Result.error();
        }
    
        @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
        @Transactional(rollbackFor = Exception.class)
        public Result delete(@PathVariable Integer id, @RequestParam(required = false) Boolean cascade) {
            permissionService.requireAdmin();
            if (categoryMapper.selectById(id) == null) {
                return Result.error("404", "分类不存在");
            }
    
            QueryWrapper<Course> courseQuery = new QueryWrapper<>();
            courseQuery.eq("category_id", id);
            Long courseCount = courseMapper.selectCount(courseQuery);
    
            if (courseCount > 0 && !Boolean.TRUE.equals(cascade)) {
                Map<String, Object> data = new HashMap<>();
                data.put("hasCourses", true);
                data.put("courseCount", courseCount);
                return Result.error("409", "该分类下还有课程，请先处理课程或选择级联删除", data);
            }
    
            int deletedCourses = 0;
            if (courseCount > 0) {
                deletedCourses = courseMapper.delete(courseQuery);
            }
    
            int row = categoryMapper.deleteById(id);
            if (row <= 0) {
                return Result.error();
            }
    
            Map<String, Object> data = new HashMap<>();
            data.put("deletedCourses", deletedCourses);
            return Result.success(data);
        }
    
        private Result checkCategory(CourseCategory category) {
            if (category == null) {
                return Result.error("400", "分类信息不能为空");
            }
            if (category.getName() == null || category.getName().trim().isEmpty()) {
                return Result.error("400", "分类名称不能为空");
            }
            return null;
        }
    
        private void fixSortOrder(CourseCategory category) {
            if (category.getSortOrder() == null || category.getSortOrder() <= 0) {
                category.setSortOrder(null);
            }
        }
    }
