    package com.cupk.aiacademy.common;
    
    import io.jsonwebtoken.Claims;
    import io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts;
    import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    
    import javax.crypto.SecretKey;
    import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
    import java.util.Date;
    
    @Component
    public class JwtUtils {
        @Value("${jwt.secret}")
        private String secret;
    
        @Value("${jwt.expiration}")
        private long expiration;
    
        public String createToken(Integer userId, String username, String roleCode) {
            Date now = new Date();
            Date expireTime = new Date(now.getTime() + expiration);
            return Jwts.builder()
                    .subject(username)
                    .claim("userId", userId)
                    .claim("roleCode", roleCode)
                    .issuedAt(now)
                    .expiration(expireTime)
                    .signWith(getSecretKey())
                    .compact();
        }
    
        public Claims parseToken(String token) {
            return Jwts.parser()
                    .verifyWith(getSecretKey())
                    .build()
                    .parseSignedClaims(token)
                    .getPayload();
        }
    
        private SecretKey getSecretKey() {
            String key = secret =[REDACTED] null ? "" : secret.trim();
            byte[] keyBytes = key.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            if (keyBytes.length < 32) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("JWT secret must be at least 32 bytes");
            }
            return Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(keyBytes);
        }
    }
    package com.cupk.aiacademy.controller;
    
    import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.conditions.query.QueryWrapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.Result;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.dto.CourseCategoryDto;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.CourseCategoryMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.CourseMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.Course;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.CourseCategory;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.service.CourseResourceService;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.service.PermissionService;
    import jakarta.validation.Valid;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
    import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.DeleteMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PutMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
    
    import java.time.LocalDateTime;
    import java.util.HashMap;
    import java.util.Map;
    
    @RestController
    @RequestMapping("/categories")
    public class CategoryController {
        @Autowired
        private CourseCategoryMapper categoryMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private CourseMapper courseMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private CourseResourceService courseResourceService;
    
        @Autowired
        private PermissionService permissionService;
    
        @GetMapping
        public Result list() {
            QueryWrapper<CourseCategory> queryWrapper = new QueryWrapper<>();
            queryWrapper.orderByAsc("id");
            return Result.success(categoryMapper.selectList(queryWrapper));
        }
    
        @GetMapping("/{categoryId}/courses")
        public Result listCourses(@PathVariable Integer categoryId,
                                  @RequestParam(required = false) Integer status,
                                  @RequestParam(defaultValue = "1") Integer pageNum,
                                  @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10") Integer pageSize) {
            return Result.success(courseResourceService.listCoursesByCategory(categoryId, status, pageNum, pageSize));
        }
    
        @PostMapping
        public Result add(@Valid @RequestBody(required = false) CourseCategoryDto request) {
            permissionService.requireAdmin();
            CourseCategory category = request == null ? null : request.toEntity();
            Result checkResult = checkCategory(category);
            if (checkResult != null) {
                return checkResult;
            }
            category.setName(category.getName().trim());
            fixSortOrder(category);
            LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
            category.setCreateTime(now);
            category.setUpdateTime(now);
            int row = categoryMapper.insert(category);
            return row > 0 ? Result.success() : Result.error();
        }
    
        @PutMapping("/{id}")
        public Result update(@PathVariable Integer id, @Valid @RequestBody CourseCategoryDto request) {
            permissionService.requireAdmin();
            CourseCategory category = request.toEntity();
            if (categoryMapper.selectById(id) == null) {
                return Result.error("404", "分类不存在");
            }
            Result checkResult = checkCategory(category);
            if (checkResult != null) {
                return checkResult;
            }
            category.setId(id);
            category.setName(category.getName().trim());
            fixSortOrder(category);
            category.setUpdateTime(LocalDateTime.now());
            int row = categoryMapper.updateById(category);
            return row > 0 ? Result.success() : Result.error();
        }
    
        @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
        @Transactional(rollbackFor = Exception.class)
        public Result delete(@PathVariable Integer id, @RequestParam(required = false) Boolean cascade) {
            permissionService.requireAdmin();
            if (categoryMapper.selectById(id) == null) {
                return Result.error("404", "分类不存在");
            }
    
            QueryWrapper<Course> courseQuery = new QueryWrapper<>();
            courseQuery.eq("category_id", id);
            Long courseCount = courseMapper.selectCount(courseQuery);
    
            if (courseCount > 0 && !Boolean.TRUE.equals(cascade)) {
                Map<String, Object> data = new HashMap<>();
                data.put("hasCourses", true);
                data.put("courseCount", courseCount);
                return Result.error("409", "该分类下还有课程，请先处理课程或选择级联删除", data);
            }
    
            int deletedCourses = 0;
            if (courseCount > 0) {
                deletedCourses = courseMapper.delete(courseQuery);
            }
    
            int row = categoryMapper.deleteById(id);
            if (row <= 0) {
                return Result.error();
            }
    
            Map<String, Object> data = new HashMap<>();
            data.put("deletedCourses", deletedCourses);
            return Result.success(data);
        }
    
        private Result checkCategory(CourseCategory category) {
            if (category == null) {
                return Result.error("400", "分类信息不能为空");
            }
            if (category.getName() == null || category.getName().trim().isEmpty()) {
                return Result.error("400", "分类名称不能为空");
            }
            return null;
        }
    
        private void fixSortOrder(CourseCategory category) {
            if (category.getSortOrder() == null || category.getSortOrder() <= 0) {
                category.setSortOrder(null);
            }
        }
    }

    +    $payload = @{sub=$role; userId=$id; roleCode=$role; exp=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(15).ToUnixTimeSeconds()} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

    +    try { return "$head.$body.$(Base64Url ($hmac.ComputeHash([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes("$head.$body"))))" } finally { $hmac.Dispose() }
    +}
    +function Request($method, $path, $token, $body = $null) {
    +    $args = @{Method=$method; Uri="http://127.0.0.1:8082$path"; SkipHttpErrorCheck=$true; TimeoutSec=10}
    +    if ($token) { $args.Headers = @{Authorization="Bearer $token"} }
    +    if ($null -ne $body) { $args.ContentType='application/json'; $args.Body=($body | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) }
    +    $r = Invoke-WebRequest @args
    +    $json = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json
    +    return @{status=[int]$r.StatusCode; json=$json}
    +}
    +function Check($condition, $message) {
    +    if (-not $condition) { throw "FAIL $message" }
    +    Write-Output "PASS $message"

    +        foreach ($action in @('create','update','delete','cascade')) {

    +                'create' { Request POST '/categories' $token @{name="forbidden $role"} }
    +                'update' { Request PUT "/categories/$id" $token @{name='unauthorized edit'} }
    +                'delete' { Request DELETE "/categories/$id" $token }
    +                'cascade' { Request DELETE "/categories/${id}?cascade=true" $token }
    +            }
    +            Check ($r.status -eq $expected) "$role $action returns $expected"
    +        }
    +        $verify = Request GET '/categories' $admin
    +        $unchanged = @($verify.json.data | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $id -and $_.name -eq 'HTTP security synthetic' })
    +        $courses = Request GET "/categories/$id/courses" $admin
    +        $found = @($courses.json.data.records | Where-Object title -eq 'HTTP security synthetic course')
    +        Check ($unchanged.Count -eq 1 -and $found.Count -eq 1) "$role attempts leave category and course intact"
    +    }
    +    $update = Request PUT "/categories/$id" $admin @{name='HTTP security synthetic updated'}
    +    Check ($update.status -eq 200 -and $update.json.code -eq '200') 'admin updates category'
    +    $delete = Request DELETE "/categories/${id}?cascade=true" $admin
    +    Check ($delete.status -eq 200 -and $delete.json.code -eq '200' -and $delete.json.data.deletedCourses -eq 1) 'admin cascade deletes synthetic category and course'
    +    $verify = Request GET '/categories' $admin
    +    Check (@($verify.json.data | Where-Object id -eq $id).Count -eq 0) 'admin confirms category removed'
    +    $create = Request POST '/categories' $admin @{name='HTTP security normal delete'}
    +    $list = Request GET '/categories' $admin

    function Base64Url([byte[]]$bytes) { [Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes).TrimEnd('=').Replace('+','-').Replace('/','_') }
    function Token([int]$id, [string]$role) {
        $head = Base64Url ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes('{"alg":"HS256"}'))
        $payload = @{sub=$role; userId=$id; roleCode=$role; exp=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(15).ToUnixTimeSeconds()} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
        $body = Base64Url ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($payload))
        $hmac = [Security.Cryptography.HMACSHA256]::new([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($env:JWT_SECRET))
        try { return "$head.$body.$(Base64Url ($hmac.ComputeHash([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes("$head.$body"))))" } finally { $hmac.Dispose() }
    }
    function Request($method, $path, $token, $body = $null) {
        $args = @{Method=$method; Uri="http://127.0.0.1:8082$path"; SkipHttpErrorCheck=$true; TimeoutSec=10}
        if ($token) { $args.Headers = @{Authorization="Bearer $token"} }
        if ($null -ne $body) { $args.ContentType='application/json'; $args.Body=($body | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) }
        $r = Invoke-WebRequest @args
        $json = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json
        return @{status=[int]$r.StatusCode; json=$json}
    }
    function Check($condition, $message) {
        if (-not $condition) { throw "FAIL $message" }
        Write-Output "PASS $message"
    }
    $process = $null
    try {
        $jar = Join-Path $build 'target\Final_exam_question_bank-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar'
        $process = Start-Process -FilePath 'java.exe' -ArgumentList @('-jar', "`"$jar`"") -WorkingDirectory $build -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput (Join-Path $out 'http-server.log') -RedirectStandardError (Join-Path $out 'http-server-error.log')
        $ready = $false
        for ($i=0; $i -lt 90; $i++) {
            if ($process.HasExited) { throw "Server exited with code $($process.ExitCode)" }
            try { $probe = Request GET '/categories' $null; $ready = $true; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
        }
        Check $ready 'isolated server started on 127.0.0.1:8082'
        $admin = Token 1 'admin'; $teacher = Token 2 'teacher'; $student = Token 3 'student'
        $create = Request POST '/categories' $admin @{name='HTTP security synthetic'; description='isolated test'; sortOrder=88}
        Check ($create.status -eq 200 -and $create.json.code -eq '200') 'admin creates synthetic category'
        $list = Request GET '/categories' $admin
        $cat = @($list.json.data | Where-Object name -eq 'HTTP security synthetic')
        Check ($cat.Count -eq 1) 'admin reads synthetic category'
        $id = $cat[0].id
        $course = Request POST '/courses' $admin @{title='HTTP security synthetic course'; categoryId=$id; teacherId=2; teacher='test'; difficulty='beginner'; status=1}
        Check ($course.status -eq 200 -and $course.json.code -eq '200') 'admin creates synthetic course'
        foreach ($entry in @(@('student',$student),@('teacher',$teacher),@('anonymous',$null))) {
            $role=$entry[0]; $token=$entry[1]; $expected=if ($role -eq 'anonymous') {401} else {403}
            foreach ($action in @('create','update','delete','cascade')) {
                $r = switch ($action) {
                    'create' { Request POST '/categories' $token @{name="forbidden $role"} }
                    'update' { Request PUT "/categories/$id" $token @{name='unauthorized edit'} }
                    'delete' { Request DELETE "/categories/$id" $token }
                    'cascade' { Request DELETE "/categories/${id}?cascade=true" $token }
                }
                Check ($r.status -eq $expected) "$role $action returns $expected"
            }
            $verify = Request GET '/categories' $admin
            $unchanged = @($verify.json.data | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $id -and $_.name -eq 'HTTP security synthetic' })
            $courses = Request GET "/categories/$id/courses" $admin
            $found = @($courses.json.data.records | Where-Object title -eq 'HTTP security synthetic course')
            Check ($unchanged.Count -eq 1 -and $found.Count -eq 1) "$role attempts leave category and course intact"
        }
        $update = Request PUT "/categories/$id" $admin @{name='HTTP security synthetic updated'}
        Check ($update.status -eq 200 -and $update.json.code -eq '200') 'admin updates category'
        $delete = Request DELETE "/categories/${id}?cascade=true" $admin
        Check ($delete.status -eq 200 -and $delete.json.code -eq '200' -and $delete.json.data.deletedCourses -eq 1) 'admin cascade deletes synthetic category and course'
        $verify = Request GET '/categories' $admin
        Check (@($verify.json.data | Where-Object id -eq $id).Count -eq 0) 'admin confirms category removed'
        $create = Request POST '/categories' $admin @{name='HTTP security normal delete'}
        $list = Request GET '/categories' $admin
        $normal = @($list.json.data | Where-Object name -eq 'HTTP security normal delete')
        Check ($create.json.code -eq '200' -and $normal.Count -eq 1) 'admin creates normal-delete category'
        $delete = Request DELETE "/categories/$($normal[0].id)" $admin
        Check ($delete.status -eq 200 -and $delete.json.code -eq '200') 'admin normal delete succeeds'

    # A running desktop may predate newly saved User environment variables.
    # Preserve explicit process settings; import only the model role variables that are missing.
    foreach ($modelVariable in @('SILICONFLOW_API_KEY',
            'RAG_EMBEDDING_ENABLED','RAG_EMBEDDING_BASE_URL','RAG_EMBEDDING_MODEL','RAG_EMBEDDING_API_KEY','RAG_EMBEDDING_APIKEY','RAG_EMBEDDING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS',

        if (-not [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($modelVariable, 'Process')) {
            $modelUserValue = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($modelVariable, 'User')
            if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($modelUserValue)) {
                [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($modelVariable, $modelUserValue, 'Process')
            }
        }
    }
    $privateSettings = Join-Path $projectRoot '.env.local'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $privateSettings) {
        foreach ($line in Get-Content -LiteralPath $privateSettings) {
            if ($line -match '^([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+)=(.*)$' -and $Matches[2] -ne '' -and
                -not [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($Matches[1], 'Process')) {
                [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($Matches[1], $Matches[2], 'Process')
            }
        }
    }
    if (-not $env:JWT_SECRET) {
        if ($UseMySql) { throw 'Set a private JWT_SECRET (at least 32 bytes) before using the MySQL profile.' }
        $env:JWT_SECRET = '[REDACTED]'
    }
    $backendRoot = Join-Path $projectRoot 'ai-learning-backend'
    $javaExecutable = if ($JavaRuntimeHome) { Join-Path $JavaRuntimeHome 'bin/java.exe' } else { 'java' }
    # Java writes its version to stderr even on success. Windows PowerShell 5 with
    # ErrorActionPreference=Stop otherwise treats that output as a NativeCommandError.
    $versionStart = New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo
    $versionStart.FileName = $javaExecutable
    $versionStart.Arguments = '-version'
    $versionStart.UseShellExecute = $false
    $versionStart.CreateNoWindow = $true
    $versionStart.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
    $versionStart.RedirectStandardError = $true
    $versionProcess = [System.Diagnostics.Process]::Start($versionStart)
    try {
        if (-not $versionProcess.WaitForExit(10000)) {
            $versionProcess.Kill()
            throw 'Java version check timed out.'
        }
        $versionText = $versionProcess.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd() + $versionProcess.StandardError.ReadToEnd()
        if ($versionProcess.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw 'Java version check failed.' }
    } finally { $versionProcess.Dispose() }
    if ($versionText -notmatch 'version "(\d+)' -or [int]$Matches[1] -lt 21) {
        throw 'Java 21+ is required. Set JAVA_HOME or pass -JavaRuntimeHome with your JDK folder.'
    }
    if ($JavaRuntimeHome) {
        # Maven also selects its compiler/runtime through JAVA_HOME.
        $env:JAVA_HOME = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $JavaRuntimeHome).Path
    }
    Push-Location $backendRoot
    try {
        if (-not $SkipBuild) {
            & mvn '-DskipTests' package
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Backend build failed.' }
        }
        $jar = Join-Path $backendRoot 'target/Final_exam_question_bank-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar'
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $jar)) { throw 'Build the backend first.' }
        $arguments = @('-jar', $jar, '--server.address=127.0.0.1')
        if (-not $UseMySql) { $arguments += '--spring.profiles.active=contest-demo' }
        Write-Host 'Backend: http://127.0.0.1:8080. Start the frontend in another terminal: npm run dev.'
        & $javaExecutable @arguments
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Backend exited with an error; inspect the startup diagnostics.' }
    } finally { Pop-Location }

    package com.cupk.aiacademy.note;
    
    import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.conditions.query.QueryWrapper;

    import com.cupk.aiacademy.service.PermissionService;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
    import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
    
    import java.time.LocalDateTime;
    import java.util.Objects;
    
    @Service
    public class StudyNoteService {
        private final StudyNoteMapper studyNoteMapper;
        private final LessonMapper lessonMapper;
        private final ChapterMapper chapterMapper;
        private final CourseMapper courseMapper;
        private final PermissionService permissionService;
    
        public StudyNoteService(StudyNoteMapper studyNoteMapper,
                                LessonMapper lessonMapper,
                                ChapterMapper chapterMapper,
                                CourseMapper courseMapper,
                                PermissionService permissionService) {
            this.studyNoteMapper = studyNoteMapper;
            this.lessonMapper = lessonMapper;
            this.chapterMapper = chapterMapper;
            this.courseMapper = courseMapper;
            this.permissionService = permissionService;
        }
    
        @Transactional(readOnly = true)
        public StudyNoteVO getMyNote(Integer lessonId) {
            Lesson lesson = getLesson(lessonId);
            Course course = getCourseByLesson(lesson);
            requireLessonAccess(course);
    
            AuthUtils.LoginUser user = permissionService.currentUser();
            StudyNote note = findNote(user.getUserId(), lesson.getId());
            if (note == null) {
                note = buildEmptyNote(user.getUserId(), course.getId(), lesson.getId(), lesson.getTitle());
            }
            return StudyNoteVO.from(note);
        }
    
        @Transactional
        public StudyNoteVO saveMyNote(Integer lessonId, StudyNoteSaveRequest request) {
            Lesson lesson = getLesson(lessonId);
            Course course = getCourseByLesson(lesson);
            requireLessonAccess(course);
    
            AuthUtils.LoginUser user = permissionService.currentUser();
            StudyNote note = findNote(user.getUserId(), lesson.getId());
            LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
            if (note == null) {
                note = new StudyNote();
                note.setUserId(user.getUserId());
                note.setCourseId(course.getId());
                note.setLessonId(lesson.getId());
                note.setCreatedAt(now);
            }
    
            note.setTitle(fixTitle(request.getTitle(), lesson.getTitle()));
            note.setContentMd(request.getContentMd() == null ? "" : request.getContentMd());
            note.setLastVideoTime(request.getLastVideoTime() == null ? 0 : request.getLastVideoTime());
            note.setUpdatedAt(now);
    
            if (note.getId() == null) {
                studyNoteMapper.insert(note);
            } else {
                studyNoteMapper.updateById(note);
            }
            return StudyNoteVO.from(note);
        }
    
        @Transactional(readOnly = true)
        public String getDownloadContent(Integer lessonId) {
            StudyNoteVO note = getMyNote(lessonId);
            return note.getContentMd() == null ? "" : note.getContentMd();
        }
    
        @Transactional(readOnly = true)
        public String getDownloadFileName(Integer lessonId) {
            StudyNoteVO note = getMyNote(lessonId);
            String title = note.getTitle() == null || note.getTitle().isBlank() ? "study-note" : note.getTitle().trim();
            return title.replaceAll("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|\\r\\n]+", "_") + ".md";
        }
    
        private StudyNote findNote(Integer userId, Integer lessonId) {
            return studyNoteMapper.selectOne(new QueryWrapper<StudyNote>()
                    .eq("user_id", userId)
                    .eq("lesson_id", lessonId)
                    .last("LIMIT 1"));
        }
    
        private StudyNote buildEmptyNote(Integer userId, Integer courseId, Integer lessonId, String lessonTitle) {
            StudyNote note = new StudyNote();
            note.setUserId(userId);
            note.setCourseId(courseId);
            note.setLessonId(lessonId);
            note.setTitle(fixTitle("", lessonTitle));
            note.setContentMd("");
            note.setLastVideoTime(0);
            return note;
        }
    
        private Lesson getLesson(Integer lessonId) {
            if (lessonId == null || lessonId <= 0) {
                throw new BusinessException("课时不能为空");
            }
            Lesson lesson = lessonMapper.selectById(lessonId);
            if (lesson == null) {
                throw new BusinessException("课时不存在");
            }
            return lesson;
        }
    
        private Course getCourseByLesson(Lesson lesson) {
            Chapter chapter = chapterMapper.selectById(lesson.getChapterId());
            if (chapter == null) {
                throw new BusinessException("章节不存在");
            }
            Course course = courseMapper.selectById(chapter.getCourseId());
            if (course == null) {
                throw new BusinessException("课程不存在");
            }
            return course;
        }
    
        private void requireLessonAccess(Course course) {
            AuthUtils.LoginUser user = permissionService.currentUser();
            if (permissionService.isAdmin(user)) {
                return;
            }
            if (permissionService.isTeacher(user) && Objects.equals(course.getTeacherId(), user.getUserId())) {
                return;
            }
            if (permissionService.isStudent(user) && permissionService.studentCourseIds(user.getUserId()).contains(course.getId())) {
                return;
            }
            throw new ForbiddenException("无权访问该课时笔记");
        }
    
        private String fixTitle(String title, String lessonTitle) {
            String value = title == null || title.isBlank() ? lessonTitle : title.trim();
            if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
                return "学习笔记";
            }
            return value.length() > 255 ? value.substring(0, 255) : value;
        }
    }

        private void applyAnswers(ExamRecord record, SubmissionRequestsDTO.SaveAnswerRequest request) {
            if (request == null || request.getAnswers() == null || request.getAnswers().isEmpty()) {
                throw new BusinessException("答案不能为空");
            }
            for (SubmissionRequestsDTO.AnswerItem item : request.getAnswers()) {

                String normalizedAnswer = normalizeAnswer(item);
                answer.setStudentAnswer(normalizedAnswer);
                answer.setIsCorrect(null);
                answer.setGradeStatus(isBlank(normalizedAnswer) ? JudgeStatus.NOT_ANSWERED.getCode() : JudgeStatus.ANSWERED.getCode());
                answerMapper.updateById(answer);
            }
        }
    
        @Transactional

        @Transactional
        public SubmissionResponseDTO submit(Long submissionId, SubmissionRequestsDTO.SaveAnswerRequest request) {
            ExamRecord record = getEntityById(submissionId);
            requireStudentRecord(record);
            if (SubmissionStatus.fromCode(record.getStatus()) != SubmissionStatus.IN_PROGRESS) {
                throw new BusinessException("当前答卷状态不允许交卷");
            }
            checkDuration(record, true);
            if (request != null) {
                applyAnswers(record, request);
            }
            return finalizeSubmission(record, false);
        }
    
        @Transactional
        public SubmissionResponseDTO autoSubmit(Long submissionId, SubmissionRequestsDTO.SaveAnswerRequest request) {
            ExamRecord record = getEntityById(submissionId);
            requireStudentRecord(record);
            if (SubmissionStatus.fromCode(record.getStatus()) != SubmissionStatus.IN_PROGRESS) {
                return toResponse(record);
            }
            if (request != null) {
                applyAnswers(record, request);
            }
            return finalizeSubmission(record, checkDuration(record, false));
        }
    
        private SubmissionResponseDTO finalizeSubmission(ExamRecord record, boolean timeout) {
            BigDecimal objectiveScore = BigDecimal.ZERO;
            boolean hasSubjective = false;
            for (ExamAnswer answer : listAnswers(record.getId())) {
                QuestionSnapshot snapshot = snapshotOf(answer);
                QuestionType type = snapshot.questionType();
                if (type == QuestionType.SHORT_ANSWER || type == QuestionType.FILE_UPLOAD) {
                    answer.setGradeStatus(JudgeStatus.PENDING_MANUAL_REVIEW.getCode());
                    answer.setScore(BigDecimal.ZERO);
                    hasSubjective = true;
                    answerMapper.updateById(answer);
                    continue;
                }
                boolean correct = judgeObjective(snapshot, answer.getStudentAnswer());
                answer.setIsCorrect(correct ? 1 : 0);
                if (correct) {
                    BigDecimal score = snapshot.maxScore();
                    answer.setScore(score);
                    objectiveScore = objectiveScore.add(score);
                } else {
                    answer.setScore(BigDecimal.ZERO);
                }
                answer.setGradeStatus(JudgeStatus.AUTO_CORRECT.getCode());
                answerMapper.updateById(answer);
            }
            LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
            record.setObjectiveScore(objectiveScore);
            record.setSubmitTime(now);
            record.setTotalScore(objectiveScore.add(record.getSubjectiveScore() == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO : record.getSubjectiveScore()));
            record.setStatus(hasSubjective ? SubmissionStatus.PENDING_MANUAL_REVIEW.getCode() : SubmissionStatus.GRADED.getCode());
            record.setComment(timeout ? timeoutComment(record, now) : record.getComment());
            record.setUpdateTime(now);
            recordMapper.updateById(record);
            return toResponse(record);
        }
    
        @Transactional
        public SubmissionResponseDTO reportScreenSwitch(Long submissionId) {
            ExamRecord record = getEntityById(submissionId);
            requireStudentRecord(record);
            if (SubmissionStatus.fromCode(record.getStatus()) != SubmissionStatus.IN_PROGRESS) {
                return toResponse(record);
            }
            if (checkDuration(record, false)) {
                return toResponse(record);
            }
    
            UpdateWrapper<ExamRecord> increment = new UpdateWrapper<>();
            increment.eq("id", record.getId())
                    .eq("status", SubmissionStatus.IN_PROGRESS.getCode())
                    .and(wrapper -> wrapper.eq("cheated", 0).or().isNull("cheated"))
                    .setSql("screen_switch_count = COALESCE(screen_switch_count, 0) + 1")
                    .set("update_time", LocalDateTime.now());
            recordMapper.update(null, increment);
    
            record = getEntityById(submissionId);
            ExamSession exam = examSessionMapper.selectById(record.getExamSessionId());
            int limit = exam == null || exam.getMaxScreenSwitches() == null ? 3 : exam.getMaxScreenSwitches();
            int count = record.getScreenSwitchCount() == null ? 0 : record.getScreenSwitchCount();
            if (count > limit && (record.getCheated() == null || record.getCheated() == 0)) {
                LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
                record.setCheated(1);
                record.setObjectiveScore(BigDecimal.ZERO);
                record.setSubjectiveScore(BigDecimal.ZERO);
                record.setTotalScore(new BigDecimal("-1"));
                record.setSubmitTime(now);
                record.setStatus(SubmissionStatus.GRADED.getCode());
                record.setComment("切屏次数超过上限（" + count + "/" + limit + "），系统判定作弊");
                record.setUpdateTime(now);

        @Test
        void exceedingScreenSwitchLimitMarksSubmissionAsCheating() {
            setCurrentUser(TEACHER_ID, "teacher");
            QuestionResponseDTO question = questionService.create(buildSingleChoiceQuestion());
            PaperResponseDTO paper = paperService.create(buildPaperRequest(question.getId()));
    
            ExamRequestDTO examRequest = new ExamRequestDTO();
            examRequest.setClassId(CLASS_ID);
            examRequest.setName("反作弊测试考试");
            examRequest.setPaperId(paper.getId());
            examRequest.setDescription("切屏超过一次即作弊");
            examRequest.setStartTime(LocalDateTime.now().minusMinutes(1));
            examRequest.setDurationMinutes(60);
            examRequest.setStatus(ExamStatus.PUBLISHED);
            examRequest.setMaxScreenSwitches(1);
            examRequest.setDisableClipboard(true);
            var exam = examService.create(examRequest);
            assertEquals(1, exam.getMaxScreenSwitches());
            assertTrue(exam.getDisableClipboard());
    
            setCurrentUser(STUDENT_ID, "student");
            SubmissionResponseDTO submission = submissionService.start(exam.getId(), String.valueOf(STUDENT_ID));
    
            SubmissionResponseDTO firstSwitch = submissionService.reportScreenSwitch(submission.getId());
            assertEquals(1, firstSwitch.getScreenSwitchCount());
            assertEquals(false, firstSwitch.getCheated());
    
            SubmissionResponseDTO secondSwitch = submissionService.reportScreenSwitch(submission.getId());
            assertEquals(2, secondSwitch.getScreenSwitchCount());
            assertEquals(true, secondSwitch.getCheated());
            assertEquals(new BigDecimal("-1"), secondSwitch.getTotalScore());
            assertEquals(SubmissionStatus.GRADED, secondSwitch.getStatus());
            assertEquals(0, new BigDecimal("-1").compareTo(jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                    "SELECT total_score FROM t_exam_record WHERE id = ?", BigDecimal.class, submission.getId())));
            assertEquals(1, jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
                    "SELECT cheated FROM t_exam_record WHERE id = ?", Integer.class, submission.getId()));
        }
    
        @Test
        void zeroScreenSwitchLimitMarksFirstSwitchAsCheating() {
            loginAsTeacher();
            var exam = createExam(ExamStatus.DRAFT);
            jdbcTemplate.update(
                    "UPDATE t_exam_session SET max_screen_switches = 0 WHERE id = ?",
                    exam.getId());
            examService.publish(exam.getId());
    
            loginAsStudent();
            var submission = submissionService.start(exam.getId(), "student-001");
            SubmissionResponseDTO switched = submissionService.reportScreenSwitch(submission.getId());
    
            assertEquals(1, switched.getScreenSwitchCount());
            assertTrue(switched.getCheated());
            assertEquals(new BigDecimal("-1"), switched.getTotalScore());
        }
    
        @Test
        void screenSwitchAfterDeadlineIsNotCounted() {
            loginAsTeacher();

            examService.publish(exam.getId());
    
            loginAsStudent();
            var submission = submissionService.start(exam.getId(), "student-001");

    package com.cupk.aiacademy.note;
    
    import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.conditions.query.QueryWrapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.AuthUtils;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.BusinessException;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.ForbiddenException;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.dto.StudyNoteSaveRequest;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.dto.StudyNoteVO;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.ChapterMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.CourseMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.LessonMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.StudyNoteMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.Chapter;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.Course;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.Lesson;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.StudyNote;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.service.PermissionService;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
    import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
    
    import java.time.LocalDateTime;
    import java.util.Objects;
    
    @Service
    public class StudyNoteService {
        private final StudyNoteMapper studyNoteMapper;
        private final LessonMapper lessonMapper;
        private final ChapterMapper chapterMapper;
        private final CourseMapper courseMapper;
        private final PermissionService permissionService;
    
        public StudyNoteService(StudyNoteMapper studyNoteMapper,
                                LessonMapper lessonMapper,
                                ChapterMapper chapterMapper,
                                CourseMapper courseMapper,
                                PermissionService permissionService) {
            this.studyNoteMapper = studyNoteMapper;
            this.lessonMapper = lessonMapper;
            this.chapterMapper = chapterMapper;
            this.courseMapper = courseMapper;
            this.permissionService = permissionService;
        }
    
        @Transactional(readOnly = true)
        public StudyNoteVO getMyNote(Integer lessonId) {
            Lesson lesson = getLesson(lessonId);
            Course course = getCourseByLesson(lesson);
            requireLessonAccess(course);
    
            AuthUtils.LoginUser user = permissionService.currentUser();
            StudyNote note = findNote(user.getUserId(), lesson.getId());
            if (note == null) {
                note = buildEmptyNote(user.getUserId(), course.getId(), lesson.getId(), lesson.getTitle());
            }
            return StudyNoteVO.from(note);
        }
    
        @Transactional
        public StudyNoteVO saveMyNote(Integer lessonId, StudyNoteSaveRequest request) {
            Lesson lesson = getLesson(lessonId);
            Course course = getCourseByLesson(lesson);
            requireLessonAccess(course);
    
            AuthUtils.LoginUser user = permissionService.currentUser();
            StudyNote note = findNote(user.getUserId(), lesson.getId());
            LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
            if (note == null) {
                note = new StudyNote();
                note.setUserId(user.getUserId());
                note.setCourseId(course.getId());
                note.setLessonId(lesson.getId());
                note.setCreatedAt(now);
            }
    
            note.setTitle(fixTitle(request.getTitle(), lesson.getTitle()));
            note.setContentMd(request.getContentMd() == null ? "" : request.getContentMd());
            note.setLastVideoTime(request.getLastVideoTime() == null ? 0 : request.getLastVideoTime());
            note.setUpdatedAt(now);
    
            if (note.getId() == null) {
                studyNoteMapper.insert(note);
            } else {
                studyNoteMapper.updateById(note);
            }
            return StudyNoteVO.from(note);
        }
    
        @Transactional(readOnly = true)
        public String getDownloadContent(Integer lessonId) {
            StudyNoteVO note = getMyNote(lessonId);
            return note.getContentMd() == null ? "" : note.getContentMd();
        }
    
        @Transactional(readOnly = true)
        public String getDownloadFileName(Integer lessonId) {
            StudyNoteVO note = getMyNote(lessonId);
            String title = note.getTitle() == null || note.getTitle().isBlank() ? "study-note" : note.getTitle().trim();
            return title.replaceAll("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|\\r\\n]+", "_") + ".md";
        }
    
        private StudyNote findNote(Integer userId, Integer lessonId) {
            return studyNoteMapper.selectOne(new QueryWrapper<StudyNote>()
                    .eq("user_id", userId)
                    .eq("lesson_id", lessonId)
                    .last("LIMIT 1"));
        }
    
        private StudyNote buildEmptyNote(Integer userId, Integer courseId, Integer lessonId, String lessonTitle) {
            StudyNote note = new StudyNote();
            note.setUserId(userId);
            note.setCourseId(courseId);
            note.setLessonId(lessonId);
            note.setTitle(fixTitle("", lessonTitle));
            note.setContentMd("");
            note.setLastVideoTime(0);
            return note;
        }
    
        private Lesson getLesson(Integer lessonId) {
            if (lessonId == null || lessonId <= 0) {
                throw new BusinessException("课时不能为空");
            }
            Lesson lesson = lessonMapper.selectById(lessonId);
            if (lesson == null) {
                throw new BusinessException("课时不存在");
            }
            return lesson;
        }
    
        private Course getCourseByLesson(Lesson lesson) {
            Chapter chapter = chapterMapper.selectById(lesson.getChapterId());
            if (chapter == null) {
                throw new BusinessException("章节不存在");
            }
            Course course = courseMapper.selectById(chapter.getCourseId());
            if (course == null) {
                throw new BusinessException("课程不存在");
            }
            return course;
        }
    
        private void requireLessonAccess(Course course) {
            AuthUtils.LoginUser user = permissionService.currentUser();
            if (permissionService.isAdmin(user)) {
                return;
            }
            if (permissionService.isTeacher(user) && Objects.equals(course.getTeacherId(), user.getUserId())) {
                return;
            }
            if (permissionService.isStudent(user) && permissionService.studentCourseIds(user.getUserId()).contains(course.getId())) {
                return;
            }
            throw new ForbiddenException("无权访问该课时笔记");
        }
    
        private String fixTitle(String title, String lessonTitle) {
            String value = title == null || title.isBlank() ? lessonTitle : title.trim();
            if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
                return "学习笔记";
            }
            return value.length() > 255 ? value.substring(0, 255) : value;
        }
    }

    package com.cupk.aiacademy.note;
    
    import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.conditions.query.QueryWrapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.AuthUtils;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.BusinessException;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.ForbiddenException;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.dto.StudyNoteSaveRequest;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.dto.StudyNoteVO;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.ChapterMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.CourseMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.LessonMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.StudyNoteMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.Chapter;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.Course;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.Lesson;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.StudyNote;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.service.PermissionService;
    import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
    import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
    
    import java.time.LocalDateTime;
    import java.util.Objects;
    
    @Service
    public class StudyNoteService {
        private final StudyNoteMapper studyNoteMapper;
        private final LessonMapper lessonMapper;
        private final ChapterMapper chapterMapper;
        private final CourseMapper courseMapper;
        private final PermissionService permissionService;
    
        public StudyNoteService(StudyNoteMapper studyNoteMapper,
                                LessonMapper lessonMapper,
                                ChapterMapper chapterMapper,
                                CourseMapper courseMapper,
                                PermissionService permissionService) {
            this.studyNoteMapper = studyNoteMapper;
            this.lessonMapper = lessonMapper;
            this.chapterMapper = chapterMapper;
            this.courseMapper = courseMapper;
            this.permissionService = permissionService;
        }
    
        @Transactional(readOnly = true)
        public StudyNoteVO getMyNote(Integer lessonId) {
            Lesson lesson = getLesson(lessonId);
            Course course = getCourseByLesson(lesson);
            requireLessonAccess(course);
    
            AuthUtils.LoginUser user = permissionService.currentUser();
            StudyNote note = findNote(user.getUserId(), lesson.getId());
            if (note == null) {
                note = buildEmptyNote(user.getUserId(), course.getId(), lesson.getId(), lesson.getTitle());
            }
            return StudyNoteVO.from(note);
        }
    
        @Transactional
        public StudyNoteVO saveMyNote(Integer lessonId, StudyNoteSaveRequest request) {
            Lesson lesson = getLesson(lessonId);
            Course course = getCourseByLesson(lesson);
            requireLessonAccess(course);
    
            AuthUtils.LoginUser user = permissionService.currentUser();
            StudyNote note = findNote(user.getUserId(), lesson.getId());
            LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
            if (note == null) {
                note = new StudyNote();
                note.setUserId(user.getUserId());
                note.setCourseId(course.getId());
                note.setLessonId(lesson.getId());
                note.setCreatedAt(now);
            }
    
            note.setTitle(fixTitle(request.getTitle(), lesson.getTitle()));
            note.setContentMd(request.getContentMd() == null ? "" : request.getContentMd());
            note.setLastVideoTime(request.getLastVideoTime() == null ? 0 : request.getLastVideoTime());
            note.setUpdatedAt(now);
    
            if (note.getId() == null) {
                studyNoteMapper.insert(note);
            } else {
                studyNoteMapper.updateById(note);
            }
            return StudyNoteVO.from(note);
        }
    
        @Transactional(readOnly = true)
        public String getDownloadContent(Integer lessonId) {
            StudyNoteVO note = getMyNote(lessonId);
            return note.getContentMd() == null ? "" : note.getContentMd();
        }
    
        @Transactional(readOnly = true)
        public String getDownloadFileName(Integer lessonId) {
            StudyNoteVO note = getMyNote(lessonId);
            String title = note.getTitle() == null || note.getTitle().isBlank() ? "study-note" : note.getTitle().trim();
            return title.replaceAll("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|\\r\\n]+", "_") + ".md";
        }
    
        private StudyNote findNote(Integer userId, Integer lessonId) {
            return studyNoteMapper.selectOne(new QueryWrapper<StudyNote>()
                    .eq("user_id", userId)
                    .eq("lesson_id", lessonId)
                    .last("LIMIT 1"));
        }
    
        private StudyNote buildEmptyNote(Integer userId, Integer courseId, Integer lessonId, String lessonTitle) {
            StudyNote note = new StudyNote();
            note.setUserId(userId);
            note.setCourseId(courseId);
            note.setLessonId(lessonId);
            note.setTitle(fixTitle("", lessonTitle));
            note.setContentMd("");
            note.setLastVideoTime(0);
            return note;
        }
    
        private Lesson getLesson(Integer lessonId) {
            if (lessonId == null || lessonId <= 0) {
                throw new BusinessException("课时不能为空");
            }
            Lesson lesson = lessonMapper.selectById(lessonId);
            if (lesson == null) {
                throw new BusinessException("课时不存在");
            }
            return lesson;
        }
    
        private Course getCourseByLesson(Lesson lesson) {
            Chapter chapter = chapterMapper.selectById(lesson.getChapterId());
            if (chapter == null) {
                throw new BusinessException("章节不存在");
            }
            Course course = courseMapper.selectById(chapter.getCourseId());
            if (course == null) {
                throw new BusinessException("课程不存在");
            }
            return course;
        }
    
        private void requireLessonAccess(Course course) {
            AuthUtils.LoginUser user = permissionService.currentUser();
            if (permissionService.isAdmin(user)) {
                return;
            }
            if (permissionService.isTeacher(user) && Objects.equals(course.getTeacherId(), user.getUserId())) {
                return;
            }
            if (permissionService.isStudent(user) && permissionService.studentCourseIds(user.getUserId()).contains(course.getId())) {
                return;
            }
            throw new ForbiddenException("无权访问该课时笔记");
        }
    
        private String fixTitle(String title, String lessonTitle) {
            String value = title == null || title.isBlank() ? lessonTitle : title.trim();
            if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
                return "学习笔记";
            }
            return value.length() > 255 ? value.substring(0, 255) : value;
        }
    }

    package com.cupk.aiacademy.controller;
    
    import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.conditions.query.QueryWrapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.JwtUtils;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.PasswordUtils;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.Result;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.dto.UserDto;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.RoleMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.UserMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.UserRoleMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.Role;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.User;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.UserRole;
    import io.jsonwebtoken.Claims;
    import jakarta.validation.Valid;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestHeader;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
    
    import java.time.LocalDateTime;
    import java.util.HashMap;
    import java.util.Map;
    
    @RestController
    @RequestMapping("/auth")
    public class AuthController {
        @Autowired
        private UserMapper userMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private RoleMapper roleMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private UserRoleMapper userRoleMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private JwtUtils jwtUtils;
    
        @PostMapping("/register")
        public Result register(@Valid @RequestBody UserDto form) {
            if (isBlank(form.getUsername()) || isBlank(form.getPassword())) {
                return Result.error("用户名和密码不能为空");
            }
    
            User oldUser = userMapper.selectOne(new QueryWrapper<User>().eq("username", form.getUsername()));
            if (oldUser != null) {
                return Result.error("用户名已存在");
            }
    
            String roleCode = isBlank(form.getRoleCode()) ? "student" : form.getRoleCode().trim().toLowerCase();
            if (!"student".equals(roleCode)) {
                return Result.error("注册仅开放学生角色，教师账号请联系管理员创建");
            }
    
            Role registerRole = roleMapper.selectOne(new QueryWrapper<Role>().eq("role_code", roleCode));
            if (registerRole == null) {
                return Result.error("角色未初始化: " + roleCode);
            }
    
            User user = form.toEntity();
            prepareRegisteredStudent(user);
            userMapper.insert(user);
    
            userRoleMapper.insert(userRole(user.getId(), registerRole.getId()));
    
            return Result.success();
        }
    
        @PostMapping("/login")
        public Result login(@Valid @RequestBody(required = false) UserDto form) {
            if (form == null || isBlank(form.getUsername()) || isBlank(form.getPassword())) {
                return Result.error("请输入用户名和密码");
            }
    
            User user = userMapper.selectOne(new QueryWrapper<User>().eq("username", form.getUsername()));
            if (user == null || user.getStatus() == null || user.getStatus() == 0) {
                return Result.error("用户名或密码错误");
            }
    
            if (!PasswordUtils.matches(form.getPassword(), user.getPassword())) {
                return Result.error("用户名或密码错误");
            }
    
            if (PasswordUtils.needsUpgrade(user.getPassword())) {
                user.setPassword(PasswordUtils.encode(form.getPassword()));
                user.setUpdateTime(LocalDateTime.now());
                userMapper.updateById(user);
            }
    
            Role role = getUserRole(user.getId());
            String roleCode = role == null ? "student" : role.getRoleCode();
            String token;
            try {
                token = [REDACTED], user.getUsername(), roleCode);
            } catch (IllegalStateException e) {
                return Result.error("500", "登录配置异常，请联系管理员");
            }
    
            Map<String, Object> data = buildUserInfo(user, roleCode);
            data.put("token", token);
            return Result.success(data);
        }
    
        @GetMapping("/info")
        public Result info(@RequestHeader(value = "Authorization", required = false) String authorization) {
            if (isBlank(authorization) || !authorization.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
                return Result.error("请先登录");
            }
    
            try {
                Claims claims = jwtUtils.parseToken(authorization.substring(7));
                Integer userId = ((Number) claims.get("userId")).intValue();
                User user = userMapper.selectById(userId);
                if (user == null || user.getStatus() == null || user.getStatus() == 0) {
                    return Result.error("用户不存在");
                }
                Role role = getUserRole(user.getId());
                return Result.success(buildUserInfo(user, role == null ? "student" : role.getRoleCode()));
            } catch (Exception e) {
                return Result.error("登录状态已失效");
            }
        }
    
        private Role getUserRole(Integer userId) {
            UserRole userRole = userRoleMapper.selectOne(new QueryWrapper<UserRole>().eq("user_id", userId));
            if (userRole == null) {
                return null;
            }
            return roleMapper.selectById(userRole.getRoleId());
        }
    
        private void prepareRegisteredStudent(User user) {
            LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
            user.setPassword(PasswordUtils.encode(user.getPassword()));
            user.setNickname(isBlank(user.getNickname()) ? user.getUsername() : user.getNickname());
            user.setStatus(1);
            user.setCreateTime(now);
            user.setUpdateTime(now);
        }
    
        private UserRole userRole(Integer userId, Integer roleId) {
            UserRole userRole = new UserRole();
            userRole.setUserId(userId);
            userRole.setRoleId(roleId);
            return userRole;
        }
    
        private Map<String, Object> buildUserInfo(User user, String roleCode) {
            Map<String, Object> data = new HashMap<>();
            data.put("userId", user.getId());
            data.put("username", user.getUsername());
            data.put("nickname", user.getNickname());
            data.put("email", user.getEmail());
            data.put("phone", user.getPhone());
            data.put("avatar", user.getAvatar());
            data.put("roleCode", roleCode);
            return data;
        }
    
        private boolean isBlank(String value) {
            return value == null || value.trim().isEmpty();
        }
    }

        $head = Base64Url ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes('{"alg":"HS256"}'))
        $payload = @{sub=$role; userId=$id; roleCode=$role; exp=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(15).ToUnixTimeSeconds()} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
        $body = Base64Url ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($payload))
        $hmac = [Security.Cryptography.HMACSHA256]::new([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($env:JWT_SECRET))
        try { return "$head.$body.$(Base64Url ($hmac.ComputeHash([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes("$head.$body"))))" } finally { $hmac.Dispose() }
    }
    function Request($method, $path, $token, $body = $null) {
        $args = @{Method=$method; Uri="http://127.0.0.1:8082$path"; SkipHttpErrorCheck=$true; TimeoutSec=10}
        if ($token) { $args.Headers = @{Authorization="Bearer $token"} }
        if ($null -ne $body) { $args.ContentType='application/json'; $args.Body=($body | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) }
        $r = Invoke-WebRequest @args
        $json = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json
        return @{status=[int]$r.StatusCode; json=$json}
    }
    function Check($condition, $message) {
        if (-not $condition) { throw "FAIL $message" }
        Write-Output "PASS $message"
    }
    $process = $null
    try {
        $jar = Join-Path $build 'target\Final_exam_question_bank-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar'
        $process = Start-Process -FilePath 'java.exe' -ArgumentList @('-jar', "`"$jar`"") -WorkingDirectory $build -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput (Join-Path $out 'http-server.log') -RedirectStandardError (Join-Path $out 'http-server-error.log')
        $ready = $false
        for ($i=0; $i -lt 90; $i++) {
            if ($process.HasExited) { throw "Server exited with code $($process.ExitCode)" }
            try { $probe = Request GET '/categories' $null; $ready = $true; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
        }
        Check $ready 'isolated server started on 127.0.0.1:8082'
        $admin = Token 1 'admin'; $teacher = Token 2 'teacher'; $student = Token 3 'student'
        $create = Request POST '/categories' $admin @{name='HTTP security synthetic'; description='isolated test'; sortOrder=88}
        Check ($create.status -eq 200 -and $create.json.code -eq '200') 'admin creates synthetic category'
        $list = Request GET '/categories' $admin
        $cat = @($list.json.data | Where-Object name -eq 'HTTP security synthetic')
        Check ($cat.Count -eq 1) 'admin reads synthetic category'
        $id = $cat[0].id
        $course = Request POST '/courses' $admin @{title='HTTP security synthetic course'; categoryId=$id; teacherId=2; teacher='test'; difficulty='beginner'; status=1}
        Check ($course.status -eq 200 -and $course.json.code -eq '200') 'admin creates synthetic course'
        foreach ($entry in @(@('student',$student),@('teacher',$teacher),@('anonymous',$null))) {
            $role=$entry[0]; $token=$entry[1]; $expected=if ($role -eq 'anonymous') {401} else {403}
            foreach ($action in @('create','update','delete','cascade')) {
                $r = switch ($action) {
                    'create' { Request POST '/categories' $token @{name="forbidden $role"} }
                    'update' { Request PUT "/categories/$id" $token @{name='unauthorized edit'} }
                    'delete' { Request DELETE "/categories/$id" $token }
                    'cascade' { Request DELETE "/categories/${id}?cascade=true" $token }
                }
                Check ($r.status -eq $expected) "$role $action returns $expected"
            }
            $verify = Request GET '/categories' $admin
            $unchanged = @($verify.json.data | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $id -and $_.name -eq 'HTTP security synthetic' })
            $courses = Request GET "/categories/$id/courses" $admin
            $found = @($courses.json.data.records | Where-Object title -eq 'HTTP security synthetic course')
            Check ($unchanged.Count -eq 1 -and $found.Count -eq 1) "$role attempts leave category and course intact"
        }
        $update = Request PUT "/categories/$id" $admin @{name='HTTP security synthetic updated'}
        Check ($update.status -eq 200 -and $update.json.code -eq '200') 'admin updates category'
        $delete = Request DELETE "/categories/${id}?cascade=true" $admin
        Check ($delete.status -eq 200 -and $delete.json.code -eq '200' -and $delete.json.data.deletedCourses -eq 1) 'admin cascade deletes synthetic category and course'
        $verify = Request GET '/categories' $admin
        Check (@($verify.json.data | Where-Object id -eq $id).Count -eq 0) 'admin confirms category removed'
        $create = Request POST '/categories' $admin @{name='HTTP security normal delete'}
        $list = Request GET '/categories' $admin
        $normal = @($list.json.data | Where-Object name -eq 'HTTP security normal delete')
        Check ($create.json.code -eq '200' -and $normal.Count -eq 1) 'admin creates normal-delete category'
        $delete = Request DELETE "/categories/$($normal[0].id)" $admin
        Check ($delete.status -eq 200 -and $delete.json.code -eq '200') 'admin normal delete succeeds'
    } finally {
        if ($null -ne $process -and -not $process.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $process.Id; $process.WaitForExit() }
        Remove-Item Env:JWT_SECRET -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }

        @Test
        void concurrentDuplicateSubmissionsHaveOneWinner() throws Exception {
            loginAsTeacher();
            var exam = createExam(ExamStatus.DRAFT);
            examService.publish(exam.getId());
            loginAsStudent();
            var submission = submissionService.start(exam.getId(), "student-001");
            var ready = new CountDownLatch(2);
            var start = new CountDownLatch(1);
            try (var executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2)) {
                java.util.concurrent.Callable<Boolean> attempt = () -> {
                    loginAsStudent();
                    try {
                        ready.countDown();
                        if (!start.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) throw new IllegalStateException("start timeout");
                        submissionService.submit(submission.getId());
                        return true;
                    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
                        return false;
                    } finally {
                        UserContext.clear();
                    }
                };
                var first = executor.submit(attempt);
                var second = executor.submit(attempt);
                assertTrue(ready.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS));
                start.countDown();
                int succeeded = (first.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS) ? 1 : 0) + (second.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS) ? 1 : 0);
                assertEquals(1, succeeded, "concurrent submit success count");
            }
        }

        @Test
        void concurrentDuplicateSubmissionsHaveOneWinner() throws Exception {
            loginAsTeacher();
            var exam = createExam(ExamStatus.DRAFT);
            examService.publish(exam.getId());
            loginAsStudent();
            var submission = submissionService.start(exam.getId(), "student-001");
            var ready = new CountDownLatch(2);
            var start = new CountDownLatch(1);
            try (var executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2)) {
                java.util.concurrent.Callable<Boolean> attempt = () -> {
                    loginAsStudent();
                    try {
                        ready.countDown();
                        if (!start.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) throw new IllegalStateException("start timeout");
                        submissionService.submit(submission.getId());
                        return true;
                    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
                        return false;
                    } finally {
                        UserContext.clear();
                    }
                };
                var first = executor.submit(attempt);
                var second = executor.submit(attempt);
                assertTrue(ready.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS));
                start.countDown();
                int succeeded = (first.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS) ? 1 : 0) + (second.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS) ? 1 : 0);
                assertEquals(1, succeeded, "concurrent submit success count");
            }
        }

    package com.cupk.aiacademy.common;
    
    public enum SubmissionStatus {
        IN_PROGRESS(0),
        SUBMITTED(1),
        PENDING_MANUAL_REVIEW(3),
        GRADED(2);
    
        private final int code;
    
        SubmissionStatus(int code) {
            this.code = code;
        }
    
        public int getCode() {
            return code;
        }
    
        public static SubmissionStatus fromCode(Integer code) {
            if (code == null || code == 0) {
                return IN_PROGRESS;
            }
            if (code == 1) {
                return SUBMITTED;
            }
            if (code == 3) {
                return PENDING_MANUAL_REVIEW;
            }
            return GRADED;
        }
    }

            try (var executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2)) {
                java.util.concurrent.Callable<Boolean> attempt = () -> {
                    loginAsStudent();
                    try {

                        submissionService.submit(submission.getId());

                var first = executor.submit(attempt);
                var second = executor.submit(attempt);
                assertTrue(ready.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS));
                start.countDown();
                int succeeded = (first.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS) ? 1 : 0) + (second.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS) ? 1 : 0);

    import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
    import org.springframework.dao.DuplicateKeyException;
    import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
    
    import java.math.BigDecimal;
    import java.time.Duration;
    import java.time.LocalDateTime;
    import java.util.Comparator;
    import java.util.List;
    import java.util.Locale;
    import java.util.Objects;
    import java.util.stream.Collectors;
    
    @Service
    public class HomeworkSubmissionService {
        private final HomeworkAssessmentService homeworkAssessmentService;
        private final QuestionService questionService;
        private final HomeworkSessionMapper homeworkSessionMapper;
        private final HomeworkRecordMapper recordMapper;
        private final HomeworkAnswerMapper answerMapper;
        private final HomeworkPaperQuestionMapper paperQuestionMapper;
        private final PermissionService permissionService;
        private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;
    
        public HomeworkSubmissionService(HomeworkAssessmentService homeworkAssessmentService,
                                 QuestionService questionService,
                                 HomeworkSessionMapper homeworkSessionMapper,
                                 HomeworkRecordMapper recordMapper,
                                 HomeworkAnswerMapper answerMapper,
                                 HomeworkPaperQuestionMapper paperQuestionMapper,
                                 PermissionService permissionService,
                                 ObjectMapper objectMapper) {
            this.homeworkAssessmentService = homeworkAssessmentService;
            this.questionService = questionService;
            this.homeworkSessionMapper = homeworkSessionMapper;
            this.recordMapper = recordMapper;
            this.answerMapper = answerMapper;
            this.paperQuestionMapper = paperQuestionMapper;
            this.permissionService = permissionService;
            this.objectMapper = objectMapper;
        }
    
        @Transactional
        public SubmissionResponseDTO start(Long examId, String candidateId) {
            return start(examId, null, null);
        }
    
        @Transactional
        public SubmissionResponseDTO start(Long examId, String candidateId, Long studentId) {
            permissionService.requireStudent();
            Long currentStudentId = permissionService.currentUser().getUserId().longValue();
            studentId = currentStudentId;
            candidateId = String.valueOf(currentStudentId);
            HomeworkSession exam = homeworkAssessmentService.getEntityById(examId);
            if (ExamStatus.fromCode(exam.getStatus()) != ExamStatus.PUBLISHED) {
                throw new BusinessException("考试未发布，不能开始答题");
            }
            if (exam.getClassId() == null) {
                throw new BusinessException("考试未绑定教学班");
            }
            permissionService.requireStudentInClass(exam.getClassId(), currentStudentId.intValue());
            LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
            if (exam.getStartTime() != null && now.isBefore(exam.getStartTime())) {
                throw new BusinessException("考试尚未开始，当前时间：" + now + "，开始时间：" + exam.getStartTime());
            }
            if (exam.getEndTime() != null && !now.isBefore(exam.getEndTime())) {
                throw new BusinessException("考试已结束，当前时间：" + now + "，结束时间：" + exam.getEndTime());
            }
            HomeworkRecord existing = findExistingRecord(exam.getId(), candidateId, studentId);
            if (existing != null) {
                SubmissionStatus status = SubmissionStatus.fromCode(existing.getStatus());
                if (status == SubmissionStatus.IN_PROGRESS) {
                    return toResponse(existing);
                }
                throw new BusinessException("您已经完成该考试，不能重复参加");
            }
    
            HomeworkRecord record = new HomeworkRecord();
            record.setHomeworkSessionId(exam.getId());
            record.setStudentId(toNullableInt(studentId, "学生ID"));
            record.setCandidateId(candidateId);
            record.setStartTime(now);
            record.setObjectiveScore(BigDecimal.ZERO);
            record.setSubjectiveScore(BigDecimal.ZERO);
            record.setTotalScore(BigDecimal.ZERO);
            record.setStatus(SubmissionStatus.IN_PROGRESS.getCode());
            record.setCreateTime(now);
            record.setUpdateTime(now);
            try {
                recordMapper.insert(record);
            } catch (DuplicateKeyException duplicate) {
                HomeworkRecord concurrentRecord = findExistingRecord(exam.getId(), candidateId, studentId);
                if (concurrentRecord != null && SubmissionStatus.fromCode(concurrentRecord.getStatus()) == SubmissionStatus.IN_PROGRESS) {
                    return toResponse(concurrentRecord);
                }
                throw duplicate;
            }
    
            for (HomeworkPaperQuestion paperQuestion : listPaperQuestions(exam.getPaperId())) {
                Question question = questionService.getEntityById(paperQuestion.getQuestionId().longValue());
                HomeworkAnswer answer = new HomeworkAnswer();
                answer.setHomeworkRecordId(record.getId());
                answer.setPaperQuestionId(paperQuestion.getId());
                answer.setQuestionId(paperQuestion.getQuestionId());
                answer.setCorrectAnswer(joinStandardAnswers(question));
                answer.setQuestionSnapshot(snapshotOf(question, paperQuestion));
                answer.setScore(BigDecimal.ZERO);
                answer.setGradeStatus(JudgeStatus.NOT_ANSWERED.getCode());
                answerMapper.insert(answer);
            }
            return toResponse(record);
        }
    
        @Transactional
        public SubmissionResponseDTO saveAnswers(Long submissionId, SubmissionRequestsDTO.SaveAnswerRequest request) {
            HomeworkRecord record = getEntityById(submissionId);
            requireStudentRecord(record);
            if (SubmissionStatus.fromCode(record.getStatus()) != SubmissionStatus.IN_PROGRESS) {
                throw new BusinessException("当前答卷不允许继续作答");
            }
            checkDuration(record, true);
            if (request == null || request.getAnswers() == null || request.getAnswers().isEmpty()) {
                throw new BusinessException("答案不能为空");
            }
            for (SubmissionRequestsDTO.AnswerItem item : request.getAnswers()) {
                HomeworkAnswer answer = findAnswer(record.getId(), toInt(item.getPaperQuestionId(), "试卷题目ID"));
                String normalizedAnswer = normalizeAnswer(item);
                answer.setStudentAnswer(normalizedAnswer);
                answer.setIsCorrect(null);
                answer.setGradeStatus(isBlank(normalizedAnswer) ? JudgeStatus.NOT_ANSWERED.getCode() : JudgeStatus.ANSWERED.getCode());
                answerMapper.updateById(answer);
            }
            return toResponse(record);
        }
    
        @Transactional
        public SubmissionResponseDTO submit(Long submissionId) {
            HomeworkRecord record = getEntityById(submissionId);
            requireStudentRecord(record);
            if (SubmissionStatus.fromCode(record.getStatus()) != SubmissionStatus.IN_PROGRESS) {
                throw new BusinessException("当前答卷状态不允许交卷");
            }
            boolean timeout = checkDuration(record, false);
            BigDecimal objectiveScore = BigDecimal.ZERO;
            boolean hasSubjective = false;
            for (HomeworkAnswer answer : listAnswers(record.getId())) {
                QuestionSnapshot snapshot = snapshotOf(answer);
                QuestionType type = snapshot.questionType();
                if (type == QuestionType.SHORT_ANSWER || type == QuestionType.FILE_UPLOAD) {
                    answer.setGradeStatus(JudgeStatus.PENDING_MANUAL_REVIEW.getCode());
                    answer.setScore(BigDecimal.ZERO);
                    hasSubjective = true;
                    answerMapper.updateById(answer);
                    continue;
                }
                boolean correct = judgeObjective(snapshot, answer.getStudentAnswer());
                answer.setIsCorrect(correct ? 1 : 0);
                if (correct) {
                    BigDecimal score = snapshot.maxScore();
                    answer.setScore(score);
                    objectiveScore = objectiveScore.add(score);
                } else {
                    answer.setScore(BigDecimal.ZERO);
                }
                answer.setGradeStatus(JudgeStatus.AUTO_CORRECT.getCode());
                answerMapper.updateById(answer);
            }
            LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
            record.setObjectiveScore(objectiveScore);
            record.setSubmitTime(now);
            record.setTotalScore(objectiveScore.add(record.getSubjectiveScore() == null ? BigDecimal.ZERO : record.getSubjectiveScore()));
            record.setStatus(hasSubjective ? SubmissionStatus.PENDING_MANUAL_REVIEW.getCode() : SubmissionStatus.GRADED.getCode());
            record.setComment(timeout ? timeoutComment(record, now) : record.getComment());
            record.setUpdateTime(now);
            recordMapper.updateById(record);
            return toResponse(record);
        }
    
        @Transactional
        public SubmissionResponseDTO manualGrade(Long submissionId, SubmissionRequestsDTO.ManualGradeRequest request) {
            HomeworkRecord record = getEntityById(submissionId);
            requireTeacherRecord(record);
            if (request == null || request.getGrades() == null || request.getGrades().isEmpty()) {
                throw new BusinessException("批改结果不能为空");
            }
            for (SubmissionRequestsDTO.ManualGradeItem item : request.getGrades()) {
                HomeworkAnswer answer = answerMapper.selectById(toInt(item.getSubmissionAnswerId(), "答题记录ID"));
                if (answer == null) {
                    throw new BusinessException("答题记录不存在: " + item.getSubmissionAnswerId());
                }
                if (!Objects.equals(answer.getHomeworkRecordId(), record.getId())) {
                    throw new BusinessException("答题记录不属于当前答卷");
                }
                QuestionSnapshot snapshot = snapshotOf(answer);
                if (!isManualQuestion(snapshot)) {
                    throw new BusinessException("只能批改简答题或文件上传题");
                }
                BigDecimal maxScore = snapshot.maxScore();
                if (item.getScore().compareTo(maxScore) > 0) {
                    throw new BusinessException("主观题得分不能超过题目分值。题目分值：" + maxScore + "，给定分数：" + item.getScore());
                }
                answer.setScore(item.getScore());
                answer.setComment(item.getComment());
                answer.setIsCorrect(null);
                answer.setGradeStatus(JudgeStatus.MANUALLY_GRADED.getCode());
                answer.setGraderId(permissionService.currentUser().getUserId());
                answer.setGradeTime(LocalDateTime.now());
                answerMapper.updateById(answer);
            }
            List<HomeworkAnswer> answers = listAnswers(record.getId());
            BigDecimal subjectiveScore = answers.stream()
