    @@
         void concurrentDuplicateHomeworkSubmissionsHaveOneWinner() throws Exception {
    @@
         }
     
    +    @Test
    +    void concurrentManualAndAutoSubmitPreserveWinningAnswers() throws Exception {
    +        loginAsTeacher();
    +        var exam = createExam(ExamStatus.DRAFT);
    +        examService.publish(exam.getId());
    +        loginAsStudent();
    +        var submission = submissionService.start(exam.getId(), "student-001");
    +        var manualItem = new SubmissionRequestsDTO.AnswerItem();
    +        manualItem.setPaperQuestionId(submission.getAnswers().getFirst().getPaperQuestionId());
    +        manualItem.setSelectedOptionKeys(List.of("A"));
    +        var manualRequest = new SubmissionRequestsDTO.SaveAnswerRequest();
    +        manualRequest.setAnswers(List.of(manualItem));
    +        var autoItem = new SubmissionRequestsDTO.AnswerItem();
    +        autoItem.setPaperQuestionId(manualItem.getPaperQuestionId());
    +        autoItem.setSelectedOptionKeys(List.of("B"));
    +        var autoRequest = new SubmissionRequestsDTO.SaveAnswerRequest();
    +        autoRequest.setAnswers(List.of(autoItem));
    +        var ready = new CountDownLatch(2);
    +        var start = new CountDownLatch(1);
    +        try (var executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2)) {
    +            var manual = executor.submit(() -> {
    +                loginAsStudent();
    +                try {
    +                    ready.countDown();
    +                    if (!start.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) throw new IllegalStateException("start timeout");
    +                    return submissionService.submit(submission.getId(), manualRequest);
    +                } catch (BusinessException e) {
    +                    assertEquals("当前答卷状态不允许交卷", e.getMessage());
    +                    return null;
    +                } finally {
    +                    UserContext.clear();
    +                }
    +            });
    +            var automatic = executor.submit(() -> {
    +                loginAsStudent();
    +                try {
    +                    ready.countDown();
    +                    if (!start.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) throw new IllegalStateException("start timeout");
    +                    return submissionService.autoSubmit(submission.getId(), autoRequest);
    +                } finally {
    +                    UserContext.clear();
    +                }
    +            });
    +            assertTrue(ready.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS));
    +            start.countDown();
    +            var manualResult = manual.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
    +            var autoResult = automatic.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
    +            assertEquals(SubmissionStatus.GRADED, autoResult.getStatus());
    +            BigDecimal expectedScore = manualResult == null ? new BigDecimal("0.00") : new BigDecimal("5.00");
    +            assertEquals(0, expectedScore.compareTo(autoResult.getTotalScore()));
    +            if (manualResult != null) {
    +                assertEquals(SubmissionStatus.GRADED, manualResult.getStatus());
    +                assertEquals(0, expectedScore.compareTo(manualResult.getTotalScore()));
    +            }
    +            assertEquals(manualResult == null ? "B" : "A", jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
    +                    "SELECT student_answer FROM t_exam_answer WHERE exam_record_id = ?", String.class, submission.getId()));
    +            assertEquals(0, expectedScore.compareTo(jdbcTemplate.queryForObject(
    +                    "SELECT total_score FROM t_exam_record WHERE id = ?", BigDecimal.class, submission.getId())));
    +        }
    +    }

    docs/competition/development/agent-records/2026-11-03-category-security\root\records.md:1455:    text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"@'\n# 分类权限及交卷并发修复状态\n\n用户要求继续测试与修复，测试流程由 Terra 执行。Terra 初次调用曾因账号限流失败，用户要求重试后已恢复；历史限流信息不代表当前状态。根代理负责产品修复和证据审阅，不接管测试执行。\n\n## 已修复\n\n- CategoryController 在新增、更新、普通删除及 cascade 删除进入 Mapper 操作前要求管理员权限。此前学生新增、更新分类漏洞已有真实 HTTP 复现记录；删除/cascade 修复前攻击未执行，不将其标记为已复现。\n- SubmissionService 对保存答案、手动交卷、自动交卷、切屏上报及人工评分使用事务内答卷行锁。Terra 先复现并发重复交卷两次均成功，修复后仅一次成功。\n- HomeworkSubmissionService 对保存答案、提交及人工评分使用同样的事务行锁。Terra 先复现两次提交均成功，再验证修复。\n\n## 已获得的验证证据\n\n- 分类权限 3 组 MockMvc 测试通过：学生/教师写入403，匿名401，拒绝时 Mapper 无交互；管理员写入和三角色读取通过。\n- 分类修复版本完整 Maven 回归400项，0失败、0错误、15跳过。这是并发修复前的中间结果。\n- 独立8082内存H2真实HTTP角色矩阵通过；操作只涉及合成分类和课程。见 terra/http-check.log。\n- 最新考试及作业锁修复后，4项定向集成测试通过：考试重复提交、作业重复提交、考试手动/自动交卷竞争、同课时学生笔记隔离。见 terra/targeted-after-locks.log，结束时间2026-11-03T18:43:29+08:00。\n- Terra 正在执行最新完整 suite、隔离构建及最终部署验证。最终测试总数和部署状态待报告，不能用上面的中间400项结果代替。\n\n## 部署及记录边界\n\n原target JAR因8080运行进程锁定而打包失败，已有独立源码副本构建成功记录。发现并发缺陷后暂停了分类修复中间版本的部署。Terra 已获授权在最终验证通过后备份旧JAR、核实进程归属、替换并重启本机8080，保持H2教学数据、5173前端和私有配置；以实际部署报告为准。\n\nMySQL实库、高并发负载未验证；新增行锁相关的所有竞争组合也未穷尽。此前OCR扫描PDF超时、Embedding503等外部接口限制不是本轮通过项。\n\n保留此前前端修改和全部历史证据；未提交Git、未改变模型和密钥配置。根会话与子会话按照AGENTS要求导出脱敏可见记录，导出是有时间边界的快照，不包含隐藏推理。\n'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath docs/competition/development/agent-records/2026-11-03-category-security/STATUS.md -Encoding utf8\npython scripts/competition/export_agent_development_records.py --session-file 'C:\\Users\\juanzhi\\.codex\\sessions\\2026\\11\\02\\rollout-2026-11-02T10-55-17-01a19a2e-c08e-7723-9c0a-87cb96f47e37.jsonl' --output-dir docs/competition/development/agent-records/2026-11-03-category-security/root --since 2026-11-03T10:05:41.380Z --start-line 2017 --private-env-file .env.local --private-env-file .codex_tmp/official-deepseek-retry/redaction.env","workdir":"D:\\code\\program\\OnlineLearning\\ai-learning-collaboration","max_output_tokens":1800}));

    function Base64Url([byte[]]$bytes) { [Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes).TrimEnd('=').Replace('+','-').Replace('/','_') }
    function Token([int]$id, [string]$role) {
        $head = Base64Url ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes('{"alg":"HS256"}'))
        $payload = @{sub=$role; userId=$id; roleCode=$role; exp=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(15).ToUnixTimeSeconds()} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
        $body = Base64Url ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($payload))
        $hmac = [Security.Cryptography.HMACSHA256]::new([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($env:JWT_SECRET))
        try { return "$head.$body.$(Base64Url ($hmac.ComputeHash([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes("$head.$body"))))" } finally { $hmac.Dispose() }
    }
    function Request($method, $path, $token, $body = $null) {
        $args = @{Method=$method; Uri="http://127.0.0.1:8082$path"; SkipHttpErrorCheck=$true; TimeoutSec=10}
        if ($token) { $args.Headers = @{Authorization="Bearer $token"} }
        if ($null -ne $body) { $args.ContentType='application/json'; $args.Body=($body | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) }
        $r = Invoke-WebRequest @args
        $json = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json
        return @{status=[int]$r.StatusCode; json=$json}
    }
    function Check($condition, $message) {
        if (-not $condition) { throw "FAIL $message" }
        Write-Output "PASS $message"
    }
    $process = $null
    try {
        $jar = Join-Path $build 'target\Final_exam_question_bank-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar'
        $process = Start-Process -FilePath 'java.exe' -ArgumentList @('-jar', "`"$jar`"") -WorkingDirectory $build -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput (Join-Path $out 'http-server.log') -RedirectStandardError (Join-Path $out 'http-server-error.log')
        $ready = $false
        for ($i=0; $i -lt 90; $i++) {
            if ($process.HasExited) { throw "Server exited with code $($process.ExitCode)" }
            try { $probe = Request GET '/categories' $null; $ready = $true; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
        }
        Check $ready 'isolated server started on 127.0.0.1:8082'
        $admin = Token 1 'admin'; $teacher = Token 2 'teacher'; $student = Token 3 'student'
        $create = Request POST '/categories' $admin @{name='HTTP security synthetic'; description='isolated test'; sortOrder=88}
        Check ($create.status -eq 200 -and $create.json.code -eq '200') 'admin creates synthetic category'
        $list = Request GET '/categories' $admin
        $cat = @($list.json.data | Where-Object name -eq 'HTTP security synthetic')
        Check ($cat.Count -eq 1) 'admin reads synthetic category'
        $id = $cat[0].id
        $course = Request POST '/courses' $admin @{title='HTTP security synthetic course'; categoryId=$id; teacherId=2; teacher='test'; difficulty='beginner'; status=1}
        Check ($course.status -eq 200 -and $course.json.code -eq '200') 'admin creates synthetic course'
        foreach ($entry in @(@('student',$student),@('teacher',$teacher),@('anonymous',$null))) {
            $role=$entry[0]; $token=$entry[1]; $expected=if ($role -eq 'anonymous') {401} else {403}
            foreach ($action in @('create','update','delete','cascade')) {
                $r = switch ($action) {
                    'create' { Request POST '/categories' $token @{name="forbidden $role"} }
                    'update' { Request PUT "/categories/$id" $token @{name='unauthorized edit'} }
                    'delete' { Request DELETE "/categories/$id" $token }
                    'cascade' { Request DELETE "/categories/${id}?cascade=true" $token }
                }
                Check ($r.status -eq $expected) "$role $action returns $expected"
            }
            $verify = Request GET '/categories' $admin
            $unchanged = @($verify.json.data | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $id -and $_.name -eq 'HTTP security synthetic' })
            $courses = Request GET "/categories/$id/courses" $admin
            $found = @($courses.json.data.records | Where-Object title -eq 'HTTP security synthetic course')
            Check ($unchanged.Count -eq 1 -and $found.Count -eq 1) "$role attempts leave category and course intact"
        }
        $update = Request PUT "/categories/$id" $admin @{name='HTTP security synthetic updated'}
        Check ($update.status -eq 200 -and $update.json.code -eq '200') 'admin updates category'
        $delete = Request DELETE "/categories/${id}?cascade=true" $admin
        Check ($delete.status -eq 200 -and $delete.json.code -eq '200' -and $delete.json.data.deletedCourses -eq 1) 'admin cascade deletes synthetic category and course'
        $verify = Request GET '/categories' $admin
        Check (@($verify.json.data | Where-Object id -eq $id).Count -eq 0) 'admin confirms category removed'
        $create = Request POST '/categories' $admin @{name='HTTP security normal delete'}
        $list = Request GET '/categories' $admin
        $normal = @($list.json.data | Where-Object name -eq 'HTTP security normal delete')
        Check ($create.json.code -eq '200' -and $normal.Count -eq 1) 'admin creates normal-delete category'
        $delete = Request DELETE "/categories/$($normal[0].id)" $admin
        Check ($delete.status -eq 200 -and $delete.json.code -eq '200') 'admin normal delete succeeds'
    } finally {
        if ($null -ne $process -and -not $process.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $process.Id; $process.WaitForExit() }
        Remove-Item Env:JWT_SECRET -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }

    function Base64Url([byte[]]$bytes) { [Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes).TrimEnd('=').Replace('+','-').Replace('/','_') }
    function Token([int]$id, [string]$role) {
        $head = Base64Url ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes('{"alg":"HS256"}'))
        $payload = @{sub=$role; userId=$id; roleCode=$role; exp=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(15).ToUnixTimeSeconds()} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
        $body = Base64Url ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($payload))
        $hmac = [Security.Cryptography.HMACSHA256]::new([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($env:JWT_SECRET))
        try { return "$head.$body.$(Base64Url ($hmac.ComputeHash([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes("$head.$body"))))" } finally { $hmac.Dispose() }
    }
    function Request($method, $path, $token, $body = $null) {
        $args = @{Method=$method; Uri="http://127.0.0.1:8082$path"; SkipHttpErrorCheck=$true; TimeoutSec=10}
        if ($token) { $args.Headers = @{Authorization="Bearer $token"} }
        if ($null -ne $body) { $args.ContentType='application/json'; $args.Body=($body | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) }
        $r = Invoke-WebRequest @args
        $json = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json
        return @{status=[int]$r.StatusCode; json=$json}
    }
    function Check($condition, $message) {
        if (-not $condition) { throw "FAIL $message" }
        Write-Output "PASS $message"
    }
    $process = $null
    try {
        $jar = Join-Path $build 'target\Final_exam_question_bank-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar'
        $process = Start-Process -FilePath 'java.exe' -ArgumentList @('-jar', "`"$jar`"") -WorkingDirectory $build -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput (Join-Path $out 'http-server.log') -RedirectStandardError (Join-Path $out 'http-server-error.log')
        $ready = $false
        for ($i=0; $i -lt 90; $i++) {
            if ($process.HasExited) { throw "Server exited with code $($process.ExitCode)" }
            try { $probe = Request GET '/categories' $null; $ready = $true; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
        }
        Check $ready 'isolated server started on 127.0.0.1:8082'
        $admin = Token 1 'admin'; $teacher = Token 2 'teacher'; $student = Token 3 'student'
        $create = Request POST '/categories' $admin @{name='HTTP security synthetic'; description='isolated test'; sortOrder=88}
        Check ($create.status -eq 200 -and $create.json.code -eq '200') 'admin creates synthetic category'
        $list = Request GET '/categories' $admin
        $cat = @($list.json.data | Where-Object name -eq 'HTTP security synthetic')
        Check ($cat.Count -eq 1) 'admin reads synthetic category'
        $id = $cat[0].id
        $course = Request POST '/courses' $admin @{title='HTTP security synthetic course'; categoryId=$id; teacherId=2; teacher='test'; difficulty='beginner'; status=1}
        Check ($course.status -eq 200 -and $course.json.code -eq '200') 'admin creates synthetic course'
        foreach ($entry in @(@('student',$student),@('teacher',$teacher),@('anonymous',$null))) {
            $role=$entry[0]; $token=$entry[1]; $expected=if ($role -eq 'anonymous') {401} else {403}
            foreach ($action in @('create','update','delete','cascade')) {
                $r = switch ($action) {
                    'create' { Request POST '/categories' $token @{name="forbidden $role"} }
                    'update' { Request PUT "/categories/$id" $token @{name='unauthorized edit'} }
                    'delete' { Request DELETE "/categories/$id" $token }
                    'cascade' { Request DELETE "/categories/${id}?cascade=true" $token }
                }
                Check ($r.status -eq $expected) "$role $action returns $expected"
            }
            $verify = Request GET '/categories' $admin
            $unchanged = @($verify.json.data | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $id -and $_.name -eq 'HTTP security synthetic' })
            $courses = Request GET "/categories/$id/courses" $admin
            $found = @($courses.json.data.records | Where-Object title -eq 'HTTP security synthetic course')
            Check ($unchanged.Count -eq 1 -and $found.Count -eq 1) "$role attempts leave category and course intact"
        }
        $update = Request PUT "/categories/$id" $admin @{name='HTTP security synthetic updated'}
        Check ($update.status -eq 200 -and $update.json.code -eq '200') 'admin updates category'
        $delete = Request DELETE "/categories/${id}?cascade=true" $admin
        Check ($delete.status -eq 200 -and $delete.json.code -eq '200' -and $delete.json.data.deletedCourses -eq 1) 'admin cascade deletes synthetic category and course'
        $verify = Request GET '/categories' $admin
        Check (@($verify.json.data | Where-Object id -eq $id).Count -eq 0) 'admin confirms category removed'
        $create = Request POST '/categories' $admin @{name='HTTP security normal delete'}
        $list = Request GET '/categories' $admin
        $normal = @($list.json.data | Where-Object name -eq 'HTTP security normal delete')
        Check ($create.json.code -eq '200' -and $normal.Count -eq 1) 'admin creates normal-delete category'
        $delete = Request DELETE "/categories/$($normal[0].id)" $admin
        Check ($delete.status -eq 200 -and $delete.json.code -eq '200') 'admin normal delete succeeds'
    } finally {
        if ($null -ne $process -and -not $process.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $process.Id; $process.WaitForExit() }
        Remove-Item Env:JWT_SECRET -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }

            }

            }
            queryWrapper.orderByDesc("id");
            courseMapper.selectPage(page, queryWrapper);
            return Result.success(page);
        }

    """Export a redacted, bounded-in-time snapshot of visible Codex development records.

    REDACTED = "[REDACTED]"
    SECRET_NAME = re.compile(r"(?:KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD)$", re.IGNORECASE)
    STRUCTURED_SECRET_NAME = re.compile(r"(?:api[_-]?key|auth[_-]?token|access[_-]?token|token|secret|password)$", re.IGNORECASE)

    OPAQUE_TRANSPORT = re.compile(r"gAAAA[A-Za-z0-9_\-=]{30,}")
    BINARY_DATA_URL = re.compile(r"data:[A-Za-z0-9.+/\-]+;base64,[A-Za-z0-9_+/=\-]+")

        "environment_context", "in-app-browser-context", "external_codex_apps_open_page",
        "codex_apps_open_page", "context", "summary", "analysis", "thinking",
    )
    CONTEXT_BLOCK = re.compile(

        re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
    )
    BEARER = re.compile(r"(?i)\bBearer[ \t]+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=\-]{4,}")
    SK_KEY = re.compile(r"\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{8,}\b")
    URL_USERINFO = re.compile(r"(https?://)[^/\s\"'<>]+@", re.IGNORECASE)
    URL_SECRET_QUERY = re.compile(
        r"([?&](?:api[_-]?key|key|token|access_token|auth_token|secret|password)=)[^&#\s\"'<>]+",
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    SECRET_ASSIGNMENT = re.compile(

        r"[\"']?[ \t]*[:=][ \t]*)(\"[^\"\r\n]*\"|'[^'\r\n]*'|[^\s,;}&]+)"
    )
    CALL_TYPES = {"function_call", "custom_tool_call"}
    OUTPUT_TYPES = {"function_call_output", "custom_tool_call_output"}
    VISIBLE_CHANNELS = {"commentary", "final"}
    MARKDOWN_PREVIEW = 12000
    
    
    def parse_time(value: str) -> dt.datetime:
        parsed = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() is None:
            raise ValueError("A timezone-aware ISO timestamp is required")
        return parsed.astimezone(dt.timezone.utc)
    
    
    def collect_secrets(environ: Mapping[str, str], private_env_files: Sequence[Path]) -> set[str]:
        """Read secrets for replacement only; no values or secret hashes enter reports."""
        values = {str(value) for name, value in environ.items() if SECRET_NAME.search(name) and value}
        for filename in private_env_files:
            for line in Path(filename).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").splitlines():
                match = re.match(r"^\s*(?:export\s+)?([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=(.*)$", line)
                if not match or not SECRET_NAME.search(match[1]):
                    continue
                value = match[2].strip()
                if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in "\"'":

                if value:

    class Redactor:
        def __init__(self, secrets: set[str]):
            self.secrets = sorted(secrets, key=len, reverse=True)

            for secret in self.secrets:
                if len(secret) >= 4:
                    result = result.replace(secret, REDACTED)
                else:
                    result = re.sub(r"(?<!\w)" + re.escape(secret) + r"(?!\w)", REDACTED, result)
            result = BEARER.sub("Bearer " + REDACTED, result)
            result = SK_KEY.sub(REDACTED, result)
            result = URL_USERINFO.sub(r"\1" + REDACTED + "@", result)
            result = URL_SECRET_QUERY.sub(r"\1" + REDACTED, result)
    
            def assignment(match: re.Match) -> str:
                prefix, value = match.groups()
                bare = value[1:-1] if value[:1] in "\"'" and value[-1:] == value[:1] else value
                if not bare or bare.startswith(("$", "%", "<", "[REDACTED]", "os.environ", "os.getenv", "System.getenv")):
                    return match[0]

    package com.cupk.aiacademy.controller;
    
    import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.conditions.query.QueryWrapper;
    import com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.plugins.pagination.Page;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.common.Result;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.ExamRecordMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.ExamSessionMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.mapper.UserMapper;
    import com.cupk.aiacademy.pojo.ExamRecord;
    import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.DeleteMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PutMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
    
    import java.time.LocalDateTime;
    
    @Deprecated
    @RequestMapping("/exam-records")
    public class ExamRecordController {
        @Autowired
        private ExamRecordMapper recordMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private ExamSessionMapper sessionMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private UserMapper userMapper;
    
        @GetMapping
        public Result pages(@RequestParam(required = false) Integer examSessionId,
                            @RequestParam(required = false) Integer studentId,
                            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "1") Integer pageNum,
                            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10") Integer pageSize) {
            Page<ExamRecord> page = new Page<>(fixPageNum(pageNum), fixPageSize(pageSize));
            QueryWrapper<ExamRecord> queryWrapper = new QueryWrapper<>();
            if (examSessionId != null && examSessionId > 0) {
                queryWrapper.eq("exam_session_id", examSessionId);
            }
            if (studentId != null && studentId > 0) {
                queryWrapper.eq("student_id", studentId);
            }
            queryWrapper.orderByDesc("id");
            recordMapper.selectPage(page, queryWrapper);
            return Result.success(page);
        }
    
        @GetMapping("/{id}")
        public Result selectById(@PathVariable Integer id) {
            ExamRecord record = recordMapper.selectById(id);
            return record == null ? Result.error("404", "考试记录不存在") : Result.success(record);
        }
    
        @PostMapping
        public Result add(@RequestBody ExamRecord record) {
            Result checkResult = checkRecord(record);
            if (checkResult != null) {
                return checkResult;
            }
            LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
            record.setCreateTime(now);
            record.setUpdateTime(now);
            int row = recordMapper.insert(record);
            return row > 0 ? Result.success() : Result.error();
        }
    
        @PutMapping("/{id}")
        public Result update(@PathVariable Integer id, @RequestBody ExamRecord record) {
            if (recordMapper.selectById(id) == null) {
                return Result.error("404", "考试记录不存在");
            }
            Result checkResult = checkRecord(record);
            if (checkResult != null) {
                return checkResult;
            }
            record.setId(id);
            record.setUpdateTime(LocalDateTime.now());
            int row = recordMapper.updateById(record);
            return row > 0 ? Result.success() : Result.error();
        }
    
        @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
        public Result delete(@PathVariable Integer id) {
            if (recordMapper.selectById(id) == null) {
                return Result.error("404", "考试记录不存在");
            }
            int row = recordMapper.deleteById(id);
            return row > 0 ? Result.success() : Result.error();
        }
    
        private Result checkRecord(ExamRecord record) {
            if (record == null) {
                return Result.error("400", "考试记录信息不能为空");
            }
            if (record.getExamSessionId() == null || record.getExamSessionId() <= 0) {
                return Result.error("400", "考试安排不能为空");
            }
            if (record.getStudentId() == null || record.getStudentId() <= 0) {
                return Result.error("400", "学生用户不能为空");
            }
            if (sessionMapper.selectById(record.getExamSessionId()) == null) {
                return Result.error("404", "考试安排不存在");
            }
            if (userMapper.selectById(record.getStudentId()) == null) {
                return Result.error("404", "学生用户不存在");
            }
            return null;
        }
    
        private int fixPageNum(Integer pageNum) {
            return pageNum == null || pageNum <= 0 ? 1 : pageNum;
        }
    
        private int fixPageSize(Integer pageSize) {
            return pageSize == null || pageSize <= 0 ? 10 : pageSize;
        }
    }

                    Homework homework = homeworkMapper.selectById(homeworkId);
                    if (homework == null) {
                        return Result.error("404", "作业不存在");
                    }
                    permissionService.requireHomeworkTeacher(homework);
                    queryWrapper.eq("homework_id", homeworkId);
                } else {
                    java.util.List<Integer> classIds = permissionService.teacherClassIds(user.getUserId());
                    if (classIds.isEmpty()) {
                        return Result.success(page);
                    }
                    QueryWrapper<Homework> homeworkQuery = new QueryWrapper<>();
                    homeworkQuery.in("class_id", classIds);
                    java.util.List<Integer> homeworkIds = homeworkMapper.selectList(homeworkQuery).stream()
                            .map(Homework::getId)
                            .filter(id -> id != null && id > 0)
                            .toList();
                    if (homeworkIds.isEmpty()) {
                        return Result.success(page);
                    }
                    queryWrapper.in("homework_id", homeworkIds);
                }
                if (studentId != null && studentId > 0) {
                    queryWrapper.eq("student_id", studentId);
                }
            } else {
                if (homeworkId != null && homeworkId > 0) {
                    queryWrapper.eq("homework_id", homeworkId);
                }
                if (studentId != null && studentId > 0) {
                    queryWrapper.eq("student_id", studentId);
                }
            }
            queryWrapper.orderByDesc("id");
            submitMapper.selectPage(page, queryWrapper);
            return Result.success(page);
        }
    
        @GetMapping("/{id}")
        public Result selectById(@PathVariable Integer id) {
            HomeworkSubmit submit = submitMapper.selectById(id);
            if (submit == null) {
                return Result.error("404", "作业提交不存在");
            }
            checkSubmitReadPermission(submit);
            return Result.success(submit);
        }
    
        @PostMapping
        public Result add() {
            return LegacyHomeworkWritePolicy.rejectedResult();
        }
    
        @PutMapping("/{id}")
        public Result update(@PathVariable Integer id) {
            return LegacyHomeworkWritePolicy.rejectedResult();
        }
    
        @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
        public Result delete(@PathVariable Integer id) {
            return LegacyHomeworkWritePolicy.rejectedResult();
        }
    
        private void checkSubmitReadPermission(HomeworkSubmit submit) {
            AuthUtils.LoginUser user = permissionService.currentUser();
            if (authUtils.isAdmin(user)) {
                return;
            }
            if (authUtils.isStudent(user)) {
                if (!user.getUserId().equals(submit.getStudentId())) {
                    throw new com.cupk.aiacademy.common.ForbiddenException("只能查看自己的作业提交");
                }
                return;
            }
            Homework homework = homeworkMapper.selectById(submit.getHomeworkId());
            if (homework == null) {
                throw new com.cupk.aiacademy.common.BusinessException("作业不存在");
            }
            permissionService.requireHomeworkTeacher(homework);
        }
    
        private int fixPageNum(Integer pageNum) {
            return pageNum == null || pageNum <= 0 ? 1 : pageNum;
        }
    
        private int fixPageSize(Integer pageSize) {
            return pageSize == null || pageSize <= 0 ? 10 : pageSize;
        }
    }

    package com.cupk.aiacademy.controller;

    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;

    import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
    
    import java.time.LocalDateTime;
    import java.util.HashMap;
    import java.util.Map;
    
    @RestController
    @RequestMapping("/categories")
    public class CategoryController {
        @Autowired
        private CourseCategoryMapper categoryMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private CourseMapper courseMapper;
    
        @Autowired
        private CourseResourceService courseResourceService;
    
        @Autowired
        private PermissionService permissionService;
    
        @GetMapping
        public Result list() {
            QueryWrapper<CourseCategory> queryWrapper = new QueryWrapper<>();
            queryWrapper.orderByAsc("id");
            return Result.success(categoryMapper.selectList(queryWrapper));
        }
    
        @GetMapping("/{categoryId}/courses")
        public Result listCourses(@PathVariable Integer categoryId,
                                  @RequestParam(required = false) Integer status,
                                  @RequestParam(defaultValue = "1") Integer pageNum,
                                  @RequestParam(defaultValue = "10") Integer pageSize) {
            return Result.success(courseResourceService.listCoursesByCategory(categoryId, status, pageNum, pageSize));
        }
    
        @PostMapping
        public Result add(@Valid @RequestBody(required = false) CourseCategoryDto request) {
            permissionService.requireAdmin();
            CourseCategory category = request == null ? null : request.toEntity();
            Result checkResult = checkCategory(category);
            if (checkResult != null) {
                return checkResult;
            }
            category.setName(category.getName().trim());
            fixSortOrder(category);
            LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
            category.setCreateTime(now);
            category.setUpdateTime(now);
            int row = categoryMapper.insert(category);
            return row > 0 ? Result.success() : Result.error();
        }
    
        @PutMapping("/{id}")
        public Result update(@PathVariable Integer id, @Valid @RequestBody CourseCategoryDto request) {
            permissionService.requireAdmin();
            CourseCategory category = request.toEntity();
            if (categoryMapper.selectById(id) == null) {
                return Result.error("404", "分类不存在");
            }
            Result checkResult = checkCategory(category);
            if (checkResult != null) {
                return checkResult;
            }
            category.setId(id);
            category.setName(category.getName().trim());
            fixSortOrder(category);
            category.setUpdateTime(LocalDateTime.now());
            int row = categoryMapper.updateById(category);
            return row > 0 ? Result.success() : Result.error();
        }
    
        @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
        @Transactional(rollbackFor = Exception.class)
        public Result delete(@PathVariable Integer id, @RequestParam(required = false) Boolean cascade) {
            permissionService.requireAdmin();
            if (categoryMapper.selectById(id) == null) {
                return Result.error("404", "分类不存在");
            }
    
            QueryWrapper<Course> courseQuery = new QueryWrapper<>();
            courseQuery.eq("category_id", id);
            Long courseCount = courseMapper.selectCount(courseQuery);
    
            if (courseCount > 0 && !Boolean.TRUE.equals(cascade)) {
                Map<String, Object> data = new HashMap<>();
                data.put("hasCourses", true);
                data.put("courseCount", courseCount);
                return Result.error("409", "该分类下还有课程，请先处理课程或选择级联删除", data);
            }
    
            int deletedCourses = 0;
            if (courseCount > 0) {
                deletedCourses = courseMapper.delete(courseQuery);
            }
    
            int row = categoryMapper.deleteById(id);
            if (row <= 0) {
                return Result.error();
            }
    
            Map<String, Object> data = new HashMap<>();
            data.put("deletedCourses", deletedCourses);
            return Result.success(data);
        }
    
        private Result checkCategory(CourseCategory category) {
            if (category == null) {
                return Result.error("400", "分类信息不能为空");
            }
            if (category.getName() == null || category.getName().trim().isEmpty()) {
                return Result.error("400", "分类名称不能为空");
            }
            return null;
        }
    
        private void fixSortOrder(CourseCategory category) {
            if (category.getSortOrder() == null || category.getSortOrder() <= 0) {
                category.setSortOrder(null);
            }
        }
    }
